original: yato yady asau viśeṣo na sādhanaviṣayaḥ katham atas tatsiddhiḥ | siddhatvād viṣayaś cet | kathaṃ na svāśrayāṃ doṣagatiṃ spṛśet | tad asundaram | sāmānyamātrav yāptāv apy antarbhāvitaviśeṣasya sāmānyasya pakṣadharmatāvaśena sādhyadharmiṇy anumīyamānatvāt | itarathā sarvānumānocchedaprasaṅgāt |

original: tathā hi vahnyanumānam api na vahnisāmanyamātraviṣayam | tasya prāg eva siddhatvāt | nāpi tadviśiṣṭagirigocaram | vahnisāmānyasya tatsambandhitvābhāvena tadviśeṣaṇatvānupapatteḥ | sambandhasvīkāre tu yathā gotvasamavāyād gāvaḥ śābaleyādayas tathā parvato vahnitvasamavāyād vahniḥ syāt |

original: asty eva vahnitvena gireḥ saṃyuktasamavāyaḥ sambandha iti cet | tarhi nāpratipadya parvatasaṃyuktaṃ vahniviśeṣam asau śakyapratipattir iti vahniviśeṣasyaivānumānam | tatra ca proktadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ | evam indriyānumane 'pi sa eva darśanīyaḥ | tathā hi tatrāpi nendriyakaraṇikā kācit kriyopalabdhā | na khalu cchidādayaḥ kriyā indriyasādhanāḥ |
analyzed: asti eva vahni tvena gireḥ saṃyukta samavāyaḥ sambandhaḥ iti ced tarhi na a pratipadya parvata saṃyuktam vahni viśeṣam asau śakya pratipattiḥ iti vahni viśeṣasya eva anumānam tatra ca prokta doṣa prasaṅgaḥ evam indriya anumane saḥ eva darśanīyaḥ tathā hi tatra api na indriya karaṇikā kācid kriyā upalabdhā na khalu chid ādayaḥ kriyāḥ indriya sādhanāḥ

original: paraśvadhādīnām anindriyatvāt | na ca paraśvadhādisādhanā rūpādiparicchittirūpā kriyā sambhavati | tasmād yathaiva kriyātvasāmānyasya saty api karaṇamātrādhānatvavyāptatve pakṣadharmatāvaśād indriyalakṣaṇakaraṇaviśeṣasiddhis tathehāpi |

original: saty api kāryatvasya buddhimaddhetumātravyāptatve vivādādhyāsiteṣu pakṣadharmatāvaśād viśiṣṭasya buddhimataḥ siddhiḥ | anyathā sāmānyasyāpi vyāpakābhimatasya na siddhiḥ syāt | nirviśeṣasya tasyānupapatteḥ | na cāsarvajñasya kṣitidharāṅkurādikāryagrāmopādānopakaraṇasampradānaprayojanānabhijñatayā tatkartṛtvaṃ sambhavati |
analyzed: sati api kāryatvasya buddhimat hetu mātra vyāpta tve vivāda adhyāsiteṣu pakṣa dharma tā vaśāt viśiṣṭasya buddhimataḥ siddhiḥ anyathā sāmānyasya api vyāpaka abhimatasya na siddhiḥ syāt nirviśeṣasya tasya anupapatteḥ na ca asarvajñasya kṣitidhara aṅkura ādi kārya grāma upādāna upakaraṇa sampradāna prayojana anabhijña tayā tad kartṛ tvam sambhavati

original: ye hi yatkarttāras te tadupādānādyabhijñāḥ | yathā kulālādayaḥ | sarveṣāṃ ca kāryāṇāṃ īśvaraḥ kartteti samastakāryopādānādyabhijñāḥ | upādānaṃ ceha pārthivādyāḥ parmāṇavaḥ
analyzed: ye hi yad karttāraḥ te tad upādāna ādi abhijñāḥ yathā kulāla ādayaḥ sarveṣām ca kāryāṇām īśvaraḥ karttā iti samasta kārya upādāna ādi abhijñāḥ upādānam ca iha pārthiva ādyāḥ parma aṇavaḥ

original: upakaraṇaṃ samastakṣetrasamavāyinau dharmādharmau | sampradānaṃ kṣetrajñāḥ | yānayaṃ svakarmabhir abhipraiti | prayojanaṃ sukhaduḥkhopabogaḥ kṣetrajñānām iti | tena yady api buddhimaddhetukatvamātraṃ vyāptiviṣayas tathāpi tadviśeṣasya pakṣadharmatābalāt pratilambha iti viśeṣaviṣayam anumānam | na coktadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: upakaraṇam samasta kṣetra samavāyinau dharma adharmau sampradānam kṣetrajñāḥ yān ayam sva karmabhiḥ abhipraiti prayojanam sukha duḥkha upabogaḥ kṣetrajñānām iti tena yadi api buddhimat hetuka tva mātram vyāpti viṣayaḥ tathā api tad viśeṣasya pakṣa dharma tā balāt pratilambhaḥ iti viśeṣa viṣayam anumānam na ca ukta doṣa prasaṅgaḥ

original: syād etan na kāryatvamātraṃ svabhāvapratibaddhaṃ buddhimaddhetutvena | kintu tadviśeṣaḥ | yaddṛṣṭer akriyādarśino 'pi kṛtabuddhir utpadyate | tasya ca ḍṛṣṭeḥ sopajāyate yadbuddhisadbhāvābhāvānuvidhāyi dṛṣṭam | ghaṭādikāryaviśeṣa ca tathā na kāryamātraṃ tanubhuvanādy api | tasya tadbhāvābhāvānuvidhānādarśanāt |
analyzed: syāt etat na kārya tva mātram svabhāva pratibaddham buddhimat hetutvena kintu tad viśeṣaḥ yat dṛṣṭeḥ akriyā darśinaḥ upi kṛtabuddhiḥ utpadyate tasya ca ḍṛṣṭeḥ sā upajāyate yat buddhi sadbhāva abhāva anuvidhāyi dṛṣṭam ghaṭa ādi kārya viśeṣa ca tathā na kārya mātram tanu bhuvana ādi api tasya tad bhāva abhāva anuvidhāna adarśanāt

original: tad etena viśeṣeṇopādhinā prayuktāṃ buddhimaddhetukatvavyāptim upajīvan kāryatvasāmānyaṃ na tena svabhāvapratibaddham iti na tad gamayitum arhati | itarathā dhūmaprayuktāṃ dhūmadhvajavyāptim upajīvataḥ pāṇḍutvādeḥ kumudakapotādigatād api makaraketanānumānaprasaṅgaḥ | tannyāyabāhyam |

original: na hi yat kāryaṃ tad akhilam api kṛtabuddhim ātmany upajanayatīti niyamaḥ kṛtrimamaṇimauktikeṣu khātapratipūritapṛthivyāṃ ca tathādarśanābhāvāt | kiṃ ca ko 'yam kāryatvasya viśeṣaḥ | kiṃ buddhimadanvayavyatirekānuvidhānaṃ taddarśanaṃ vā | yadi pūrvaḥ kalaḥ | sa buddhimaddhetukatvaṃ tanubhuvanādīnāmātiṣṭhamānair abhyupeyata eva |
analyzed: na hi yat kāryam tat akhilam api kṛtabuddhim ātmani upajanayati iti niyamaḥ kṛtrima maṇi mauktikeṣu khāta pratipūrita pṛthivyām ca tathā darśana abhāvāt kim ca kaḥ yam kāryatvasya viśeṣaḥ kim buddhimat anvaya vyatireka anuvidhānam tad darśanam vā yadi pūrvaḥ kalaḥ sa buddhimat hetuka tvam tanu bhuvana ādīnām ātiṣṭhamānaiḥ abhyupeyate eva

original: na hi kāraṇaṃ kāryānanuvihitabhāvābhāvam anyo vaktum arhati grahagṛhītāt | atha taddarśanam |

original: tarhi ya eva paṭo 'nena buddhimadananvayavyatirekānuvidhāyī dṛṣṭaḥ sa eva tatkāryo na tu nipaṇivarttī | atha tajjātīyasya tadanvayavyatirekānuvidhānadarśanād adṛṣṭānvayavyatirekānuvidhānam api tajjātīyaṃ tatheti cet | kiṃ na tanubhuvanādy api tathā manyate | paṭājātīyam eva kārye buddhimaddhetukam iti cet |
analyzed: tarhi yaḥ eva paṭaḥ nena buddhimat ananvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyī dṛṣṭaḥ saḥ eva tad kāryaḥ na tu nipaṇivarttī atha tad jātīyasya tad anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāna darśanāt adṛṣṭa anvaya vyatireka anuvidhānam api tad jātīyam tathā iti cet kim na tanu bhuvana ādi api tathā manyate paṭa ajātīyam eva kārye buddhimat hetukam iti cet

original: nanu prāsādādikaṃ taddhetukaṃ na bhaved apaṭajātīyatvāt | athāpaṭajātīyasyāpi prāsādādikasya kena cid viśeṣeṇāsty eva paṭena sajātīyatvam | tarhi tanubhuvanāder api tathā tat kiṃ na bhaviṣyati | tataḥ svabhāvapratibaddhaṃ kāryatvaṃ buddhimaddhetukatveneti |
analyzed: nanu prāsāda ādikam tad hetukam na bhavet apaṭa jātīya tvāt atha apaṭa jātīyasya api prāsāda ādikasya kena cid viśeṣeṇa asti eva paṭena sajātīya tvam tarhi tanu bhuvana ādeḥ api tathā tat kim na bhaviṣyati tatas svabhāva pratibaddham kāryatvam buddhimat hetuka tvena iti

original: ekatvam ca kṣityādikartuḥ | anekeṣāṃ kārakāṇām ekādhiṣṭhātṛniyamitānāṃ pravṛttipratīteḥ | anekeṣāṃ sthapatīnāṃ ekasūtradhāraniyamitavyāpārāṇāṃ prāsādādikāryakaraṇe pravṛttiḥ pratīyate | na ca trilocanasya  tajjñānasya ca nityatāyām ekarūpatāyāṃ ca kāryāṇāṃ kādācitkatvaṃ vaicitryaṃ ca virodham adhirohati |

original: tadā pūrvavat prasaktiḥ | anyathā tu kādācitkatvam | nanu yady atyantabhinnakāraṇarūpopādhyapagame 'pi vastusvarūpāpagamaḥ | tarhi puruṣeṇa mukte daṇḍe tatsvarūpam apy apeyāt | so 'pi parasyāpacikīrṣayā pīyūṣagaṇḍūṣopadeśaḥ | abhyupagamyata eva hi kathaṃ cit svarūpāpagamaḥ | daṇḍagrahaṇapariṇāmaparihārapūrvaṃ puruṣeṇa tadaparapariṇāmasvīkārāt |
analyzed: tadā pūrvavat prasaktiḥ anyathā tu kādācitkatvam nanu yadi atyanta bhinna kāraṇa rūpa upādhi apagame vastu sva rūpa apagamaḥ tarhi puruṣeṇa mukte daṇḍe tad sva rūpam api apeyāt saḥ pi parasya apacikīrṣayā pīyūṣa gaṇḍūṣa upadeśaḥ abhyupagamyate eva hi katham cit sva rūpa apagamaḥ daṇḍa grahaṇa pariṇāma parihāra pūrvam puruṣeṇa tad apara pariṇāma svīkārāt

original: na caivam | tato na vyastrādisajātīyatvaṃ bhūdharāder iti siddhi jātibhede yādṛkkāryaṃ kumbhādi puruṣapratibaddhaṃ na tādṛggarbhārbhakādīty asiddhir tatra kāryatvaviśeṣasya | yādṛggarbhārbhakādikāryaṃ na tadṛk puruṣavyāptam ity avyāptiḥ kāryatvamātrasya | evaṃ ca sthite prakṛtasādhyabuddhyajananadvārāṇi dūṣaṇāni dūram apāstāni |
analyzed: na ca evam tatas na vyastra ādi sajātīya tvam bhūdhara ādeḥ iti siddhi jāti bhede yādṛś kāryam kumbha ādi puruṣa pratibaddham na tādṛś garbha arbhaka ādi iti asiddhiḥ tatra kāryatva viśeṣasya yādṛś garbha arbhaka ādi kāryam na tadṛś puruṣa vyāptam iti avyāptiḥ kāryatva mātrasya evam ca sthite prakṛta sādhya buddhi ajanana dvārāṇi dūṣaṇāni dūram apāstāni

original: na hi vayaṃ prakṛtasādhyabuddher abhāvāt kāryatvahetor asiddhiṃ brūmaḥ | kiṃ tarhi mandarādau kuvindādikartṛbuddher abhāvād vastrādisajātīyakāryatvāsiddhim | tataś ca prakṛtasādhyabuddhivaidhuryam iti na kaś cid doṣaḥ | api ca yadi ghaṭādau tathā darśanāt kāryatāmātraṃ gotrādau buddhimad dhetor anumāpakam aṅgīkriyate |
analyzed: na hi vayam prakṛta sādhya buddheḥ abhāvāt kāryatva hetoḥ asiddhim brūmaḥ kim tarhi mandara ādau kuvinda ādi kartṛ buddheḥ abhāvāt vastra ādi sajātīya kāryatva asiddhim tatas ca prakṛta sādhya buddhi vaidhuryam iti na kaḥ cid doṣaḥ api ca yadi ghaṭa ādau tathā darśanāt kāryatā mātram gotra ādau buddhimat hetoḥ anumāpakam aṅgīkriyate

original: tarhīdānīṃ tadvad eva mṛdvikāratāpi śakramūrdhani manuṣyanirmityanumāpikā kiṃ mā bhūt |  na khalv atrāpi kalaśavalmīkayor mṛdvikāratvaṃ bhidyate | na ca tādṛśasaṃsthānaviśeṣo manuśyeṇāśakyakriyaḥ | tādṛśatve 'pi tasya tadanvayavyatirekānuvidhānādarśanān na tatkāryam iti cet | na | ihāpi sāmyāt |
analyzed: tarhi idānīm tadvat eva mṛd vikāra tā api śakra mūrdhani manuṣya nirmiti anumāpikā kim mā bhūt na khalu atra api kalaśa valmīkayoḥ mṛd vikāra tvam bhidyate na ca tādṛśa saṃsthāna viśeṣaḥ manuśyeṇa aśakya kriyaḥ tādṛśa tve pi tasya tad anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāna adarśanāt na tat kāryam iti ced na iha api sāmyāt

original: ihāpi yasya yasya buddhimadbhāvānuvidhānam asti tasya sarvasyāstu tatpūrvatā prāsādādīnām | na punas tathāvidhasyāpi bhuvanāder bhavitum arhati | tasya tad anvayavyatirekānuvidhānābhāvāt |
analyzed: iha api yasya yasya buddhimat bhāva anuvidhānam asti tasya sarvasya astu tad pūrva tā prāsāda ādīnām na punar tathāvidhasya api bhuvana ādeḥ bhavitum arhati tasya tat anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāna abhāvāt

original: nanv evaṃ yo yo dhūmaviśeṣo vahnibhāvābhāvānuvidhāyibhāvābhāva upalabdhaḥ sa sarvo 'stu vahnipūrvo na tu parvatanitambavartīti kathaṃ tato vahnir anumīyate sāmānyabuddhiviśeṣaviṣāyatvena | kāraṇābhāvāvadhāraṇasyehāpi sāmyād iti cet | tat kim idānīm manuṣyakāryā kuḍyādaya upalabdhā iti śakramūrdhāpi tathāstu |
analyzed: nanu evam yaḥ yaḥ dhūma viśeṣaḥ vahni bhāva abhāva anuvidhāyi bhāva abhāvaḥ upalabdhaḥ sa sarvaḥ astu vahni pūrvaḥ na tu parvata nitamba vartī iti katham tatas vahniḥ anumīyate sāmānya buddhi viśeṣa viṣāya tvena kāraṇa abhāva avadhāraṇasya iha api sāmyāt iti ced tat kim idānīm manuṣya kāryā kuḍya ādayaḥ upalabdhāḥ iti śakramūrdhā api tathā astu

original: kasya cid viśeṣasya kuḍyādibhyaḥ śakramūrdhādeḥ sambhavān naivam iti cet | sa tarhi prāsādādibhyaḥ sambhavati bhuvanāder apīti na viśeṣaḥ | na tv evaṃvidho vahnyanvayavyatirekānuvidhāyināṃ dhūmaviśeṣānāṃ parvatagatād dhūmāt svarūpeṇa viśeṣo 'sti |
analyzed: kasya cit viśeṣasya kuḍya ādibhyaḥ śakramūrdha ādeḥ sambhavāt na evam iti ced sa tarhi prāsāda ādibhyaḥ sambhavati bhuvana ādeḥ api iti na viśeṣaḥ na tu evaṃvidhaḥ vahni anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyinām dhūma viśeṣānām parvata gatāt dhūmāt sva rūpeṇa viśeṣaḥ sti

original: ata eva na pāṇḍudravyamātrāt kumudakapotāder dahanānumānam | dhūmatvāsāmānyasyaiva tato bhedāpādakatvāt | kiṃ ca | yadi kumbhādau kāryatvamātrasya buddhimadanvayavyatirekānuvidhānadarśanāt pṛthivyādāv api kāryateṣyate | tarhi keṣāṃ cin maṇimuktādīnāṃ puruṣānvayavyatirekānuvidhānasyopalambhād ratnākarasamutthānām api tatkāryatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: atas eva na pāṇḍu dravya mātrāt kumuda kapota ādeḥ dahana anumānam dhūma tva asāmānyasya eva tatas bheda āpādaka tvāt kim ca yadi kumbha ādau kāryatva mātrasya buddhimat anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāna darśanāt pṛthivī ādau api kāryatā iṣyate tarhi keṣām cit maṇi muktā ādīnām puruṣa anvaya vyatireka anuvidhānasya upalambhāt ratnākara samutthānām api tad kāryatva prasaṅgaḥ

original: iṣyata evaṃ puruṣas tatrāpīśvaraḥ karteti cet | kathaṃ tarhi tatrākṛtrimavyavahāro lokasyāskhaladrūpaḥ | tatreśvarasya kartur atīndriyatvenānupalambhād iti cet | na | anyatrāpi sarvatra kartur anupalambhād deśakālaviprakṛṣṭasya kartur upalambhāsambhavād atas teṣu apy adṛṣṭakartṛkeṣv akṛtrimavyavahāraḥ |
analyzed: iṣyate evam puruṣaḥ tatra api īśvaraḥ kartā iti ced katham tarhi tatra akṛtrima vyavahāraḥ lokasya a skhalat rūpaḥ tatra īśvarasya kartuḥ atīndriya tvena anupalambhāt iti ced na anyatra api sarvatra kartuḥ anupalambhāt deśa kāla viprakṛṣṭasya kartuḥ upalambha asambhavāt atas teṣu api adṛṣṭa kartṛkeṣu akṛtrima vyavahāraḥ

original: sāgarasamutthādibhiḥ samānārthatātha vā syād aviśeṣāt | tajjātīyeṣu kartur upalambhād adṛṣṭakartṛkeṣv api kartur anumānāt kṛtrimavyavahāra iti cet | sāmudreṣv api dṛṣṭakartṛkasamānajātīyatvena kartur anumānāt kṛtrimavyavahāraḥ kiṃ na syāt | anyathātrāpi mā bhūd aviśeṣāt |
analyzed: sāgara samuttha ādibhiḥ samāna artha tā atha vā syāt aviśeṣāt tad jātīyeṣu kartuḥ upalambhāt adṛṣṭa kartṛkeṣu api kartuḥ anumānāt kṛtrima vyavahāraḥ iti ced sāmudreṣu api dṛṣṭa kartṛka samāna jātīya tvena kartuḥ anumānāt kṛtrima vyavahāraḥ kim na syāt anyathā atra api mā bhūt aviśeṣāt

original: sāmudrāṇāṃ dṛṣṭakartṛkamaṇyādivijātīyatvena kartranumānayogāt kṛtrimavyavahārābhāve sthāvarādikāryasyāpi dṛṣṭakartṛkaprāsādādikāryavijātīyatvāt | kartranumānaṃ na syād aviśeṣāt | tasmād dṛṣṭakartṛkasajātīyānām eva kartranumānaṃ yuktam | yathā nadanadīparvatādīnāṃ | laukikaparīkṣakayos tatra kṛṭabuddhyanutpatteḥ |
analyzed: sāmudrāṇām dṛṣṭa kartṛka maṇi ādi vijātīya tvena kartṛ anumāna yogāt kṛtrima vyavahāra abhāve sthāvara ādi kāryasya api dṛṣṭa kartṛka prāsāda ādi kārya vijātīya tvāt kartṛ anumānam na syāt aviśeṣāt tasmāt dṛṣṭa kartṛka sajātīyānām eva kartṛ anumānam yuktam yathā nada nadī parvata ādīnām laukika parīkṣakayoḥ tatra kṛṭa buddhi anutpatteḥ

original: evaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ kāryatam asiddhaṃ vasudhādiṣu | kāryatvamātraṃ punar aprasiddhavyāptikam iti sthitam | yac ca pratyakṣādibhir abādhyamānapakṣatvena kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvaṃ pratyādiṣṭam | tad api na spaṣṭam | pakṣaikadeśasya tṛṇāder grahaṇayogyakartṛkasyāpy agṛhyamāṇakartṛkatayā pratyakṣeṇa bādhanāt |
analyzed: evam viśiṣṭam asiddham vasudhā ādiṣu kāryatva mātram punar aprasiddha vyāptikam iti sthitam yat ca pratyakṣa ādibhiḥ abādhyamāna pakṣa tvena kāla atyaya apadiṣṭa tvam pratyādiṣṭam tat api na spaṣṭam pakṣa eka deśasya tṛṇa ādeḥ grahaṇa yogya kartṛkasya api agṛhyamāṇa kartṛka tayā pratyakṣeṇa bādhanāt

original: atha na pratyakṣeṇa pakṣaikadeśo'tra bādhituṃ śakyaḥ | kartur pratyakseṇa grahītum ayogyatvād iti cet | na | pratyakṣānupalambhābhyāṃ vyāptigrahaṇāṅgīkāreṇa dṛśya eva viṣaye sādhanābhidhānasya haṭhenāyātatvād ity uktam |
analyzed: atha na pratyakṣeṇa pakṣa eka deśaḥ utra bādhitum śakyaḥ kartuḥ grahītum ayogya tvāt iti ced na pratyakṣa anupalambhābhyām vyāpti grahaṇa aṅgīkāreṇa dṛśye eva viṣaye sādhana abhidhānasya haṭhena āyāta tvāt iti uktam

original: api ca | jñātacikīrṣāprayatnaśarīraśālī khalv ātmā mūrtaḥ kartā bhavati | kulālādes tathopalambhāt | evambhūtaś ca kartā pratyakṣagrahaṇayogya eva | yady api jñānādibhāgo na yogyaḥ | tathāpi yogyaśarīrabhāgabādhād bhavati pratyakṣāṃ bādhakam | atha jñānacikīrṣāprayatnavān eva kartābhidhīyate na śarīravān api |
analyzed: api ca jñāta cikīrṣā prayatna śarīra śālī khalu ātmā mūrtaḥ kartā bhavati kulāla ādeḥ tathā upalambhāt evambhūtaḥ ca kartā pratyakṣa grahaṇa yogyaḥ eva yadi api jñāna ādi bhāgaḥ na yogyaḥ tathā api yogya śarīra bhāga bādhāt bhavati pratyakṣām bādhakam atha jñāna cikīrṣā prayatnavān eva kartā abhidhīyate na śarīravān api

original: nanu śarīraṃ kuto na kartṛtvabhāganiveśi | jñānotpattāv upayuktatvād iti cet | tarhi jñānam api tyajyatām | icchopayogitvāt | icchāpi tyajyatāṃ prayatnopayogitvāt | tataḥ prayatnamātraśālī kartā prāptaḥ | tathā ca na cetanaḥ kartety aho kamanīyaṃ kartṛtvam ālokyāṃ cakrur yogāḥ | tasmāj jñānādicatuṣṭayaśālī kartā vācyaḥ |
analyzed: nanu śarīram kutas na kartṛ tva bhāga niveśi jñāna utpattau upayukta tvāt iti cet tarhi jñānam api tyajyatām icchā upayogi tvāt icchā api tyajyatām prayatna upayogi tvāt tatas prayatna mātra śālī kartā prāptaḥ tathā ca na cetanaḥ kartā iti aho kamanīyam kartṛ tvam ālokyām cakruḥ yogāḥ tasmāt jñāna ādi catuṣṭaya śālī kartā vācyaḥ

original: evaṃ ca bhavati pratyakṣaṃ bādhakam | atha na śarīraṃ kartṛbhāganiviṣṭam anyatropakṣīṇatvāt | jñānam antareṇa tu na kartṛtvam | na hy atra jñānam icchāmātropayogi | kiṃ tv icchāprayatnayor viṣayāvacchedopayogy api | na hīcchāprayatnau svayaṃ svaviṣayapravaṇāv api tarhi jñānaviṣayāvacchedadvāriṇaiva tayoḥ saviśayatvam |
analyzed: evam ca bhavati pratyakṣam bādhakam atha na śarīram kartṛ bhāga niviṣṭam anyatra upakṣīṇa tvāt jñānam antareṇa tu na kartṛ tvam na hi atra jñānam icchā mātra upayogi kim tu icchā prayatnayoḥ viṣaya avaccheda upayogi api na hi icchā prayatnau svayam sva viṣaya pravaṇau api tarhi jñāna viṣaya avaccheda dvāriṇā eva tayoḥ sa viśaya tvam

original: tayoḥ svabhāvād viṣayāvacchede tadapalāpaprasaṅgaḥ | ayam eva hi jñānasya tābhyāṃ bhedo yad idaṃ viṣayapravaṇaṃ svabhāvāt | tasmān nānyatropayogitāmātreṇa jñānaṃ tyaktuṃ yujyate |  icchāprayatnayor viṣayāvacchedārtham adhikopayogāt | tasmāj jñānacikīrṣāprayatnādhāra eva kartā | śarīraṃ tu jñānopayogīti na kartṛtvaniveśi |
analyzed: tayoḥ svabhāvāt viṣaya avacchede tad apalāpa prasaṅgaḥ ayam eva hi jñānasya tābhyām bhedaḥ yat idam viṣaya pravaṇam svabhāvāt tasmāt na anyatra upayogi tā mātreṇa jñānam tyaktum yujyate icchā prayatnayoḥ viṣaya avaccheda artham adhika upayogāt tasmāt jñāna cikīrṣā prayatna ādhāraḥ eva kartā śarīram tu jñāna upayogi iti na kartṛ tva niveśi

original: evaṃ ca sati pratyakṣaṃ bādhakam | jñānāditrayādhārasya hi kartuḥ pratyakṣeṇa grahītum ayogyatvād iti | tad ayuktam | yato yasyāsmadāder anityāv icchāprayatnau bhavatas tasya pūrvaṃ viśayaparicchedaḥ | paricchinne ca tasmin sukhaduḥkhasādhanatām avadhārya tadanurūpāv icchāprayatnau pravartete iti vaktuṃ yuktam |

original: atha dvitīyaḥ | tadāsty eveśvare 'pi kartari paramparayā śarīravyāpāraḥ | īśvaro 'pi hi kāryajātam ārabhamāṇaḥ kṣetrajñāśritam adṛṣṭam apekṣate | tac ca śarīrāvacchinne ātmany utpannam ity asti paramparayātrāpi śarīravyāpāra iti |

original: yasmāt kṣetrajñaśarīram īśvarasya na svakarmopārjitam iti siddhaṃ svakarmopārjitaṃ śārīraṃ kartṛvyāpakaṃ tadabhāvāc ca rudre kartṛtvābhāva iti | ato 'py anumānāt prakaraṇasamatvam atra | vivādaṃ buddhimaddhetukaṃ na bhavati kartṛsukhaduḥkhājanakatvāt | yad buddhimaddhetukam tanniyamena  kartṛsukhaduḥkhajanakam | yathā ghaṭaḥ | na cedaṃ tathā |
analyzed: yasmāt kṣetrajña śarīram īśvarasya na sva karma upārjitam iti siddham sva karma upārjitam śārīram kartṛ vyāpakam tad abhāvāt ca rudre kartṛ tva abhāvaḥ iti atas pi anumānāt prakaraṇa sama tvam atra vivādam buddhimat hetukam na bhavati kartṛ sukha duḥkha ajanaka tvāt yat buddhimat hetukam tad niyamena kartṛ sukha duḥkha janakam yathā ghaṭaḥ na ca idam tathā

original: tasmān na buddhimaddhetukam iti | yat punar buddhimaddhetutāmātram atra siśādhayiṣitaṃ viśeṣo vety āśaṅkāparyante tadviśeṣasya pakṣadharmatābalāt pratilambha ity abhāṇi |
analyzed: tasmāt na buddhimat hetukam iti yat punar buddhimat hetutā mātram atra viśeṣaḥ vā iti āśaṅkā paryante tad viśeṣasya pakṣa dharma tā balāt pratilambhaḥ iti abhāṇi

original: tad apy anipuṇaṃ | pakṣadharmatā hi sādhyasya pakṣāyogavyavacchedamātram eva darśayati dhūmānumāṇādau tathaiva darśanāt | anyathā dhūmāt kṣitidharakuharāyogavyavacchedavad vahneḥ pañcavarṇaśikhākalāpatāyā apy anumānaprasaṅgaḥ | nātra sāmarthyam iti cet, evaṃ tarhi samāyātaṃ pakṣāyogavyavacchedamātra eva sāmartham |
analyzed: tat api anipuṇam pakṣa dharma tā hi sādhyasya pakṣa ayoga vyavaccheda mātram eva darśayati dhūma anumāṇa ādau tathā eva darśanāt anyathā dhūmāt kṣitidhara kuhara ayoga vyavaccheda vat vahneḥ pañca varṇa śikhā kalāpa tāyāḥ api anumāna prasaṅgaḥ na atra sāmarthyam iti ced evam tarhi samāyātam pakṣa ayoga vyavaccheda mātre eva sāmartham

original: evam ihāpi pakṣadharmatābalāt pakṣāyogavyavacchedamātrasiddhir astu | nityajñānas tu kartā kathaṃ siddhyeta | na hi mahīdharādi kāryam iti tat kva cin nityajñānena bhavitavyam iti | bhavati | matimanmātreṇa tatkartṛtvam anupapadyamānaṃ nityajñānaṃ svakartāram ākṣipatīti cet | yady evaṃ pramāṇāṇtaraprasāda eṣaḥ | anyathānumitānumānocchedaḥ |
analyzed: evam iha api pakṣa dharma tā balāt pakṣa ayoga vyavaccheda mātra siddhiḥ astu nityajñānaḥ tu kartā katham siddhyeta na hi mahīdhara ādi kāryam iti tat kva cit nityajñānena bhavitavyam iti bhavati matimat mātreṇa tad kartṛ tvam anupapadyamānam nityajñānam sva kartāram ākṣipati iti ced yadi evam pramāṇa aṇtara prasādaḥ eṣaḥ anyathā anumita anumāna ucchedaḥ

original: na ca neṣṭaṃ tat | icchādayaḥ samavāyikāraṇa anto guṇatvād ity asmād icchādīnāṃ samavāyikāraṇavattvaṃ prasādhya pariśeṣānumānād aṣṭadravyātiriktasyātmarūpadravyaviśeṣasya sādhanāt | kiṃ ca pakṣādharmatāvaśād adhiṣṭātṛviśeṣo nikhilaviṣayavarttinityavijñānamātraśālī kapālī siddhyatīti ṣaḍguṇeśvaravādināṃ matam |
analyzed: na ca na iṣṭam tat icchā ādayaḥ antar guṇa tvāt iti asmāt icchā ādīnām samavāyi kāraṇavat tvam prasādhya pariśeṣa anumānāt aṣṭa dravya atiriktasya ātma rūpa dravya viśeṣasya sādhanāt kim ca pakṣa adharma tā vaśāt adhiṣṭātṛ viśeṣaḥ nikhila viṣaya vartti nitya vijñāna mātra śālī kapālī siddhi ati iti ṣaḍguṇa īśvara vādinām matam

original: tac cāṣṭaguṇeśvaravādino na kṣamante | vadanti ca nopādānādijñānamātreṇa viśvakāryajātam utpattum arhati | na jātūpadānādijño 'pi kumbhakāraḥ kumbham acikīrṣuś cikīrṣur vā tadupādānādiṣv alasatayāprayatamānaḥ kumbhārambhāya kalpate | tasmāj jñānacikīrṣāprayatnasamudāyajanmā kāryotpādo na jñānamātrād bhavitum arhati |
analyzed: tat ca aṣṭaguṇa īśvara vādinaḥ na kṣamante vadanti ca nā upādāna ādi jñāna mātreṇa viśva kārya jātam utpattum arhati na jātu upadāna ādi jñaḥ pi kumbhakāraḥ kumbham acikīrṣuḥ cikīrṣuḥ vā tad upādāna ādiṣu alasa tayā aprayatamānaḥ kumbha ārambhāya kalpate tasmāt jñāna cikīrṣā prayatna samudāya janmā kārya utpādaḥ na jñāna mātrāt bhavitum arhati

original: na khalv ārdrendhanadahanajanmā dhūmaḥ kevalārdrendhanād vahner vā jāyate | athāstv evaṃ pṛthagjanajñāneṣu | bhagavajjñānaṃ tu tadvilakṣaṇam ity asahāyam eva viśvasmin kārye paryāptam iti cet | hanta bhoḥ kim asya jñānenāpi | svarūpātiśaya evāsyāsahāyas tatra tatra kārye vartsyatīti | na kiṃ cit kāryam asahāyād ekasmāt kuto 'pi jāyata iti cet |
analyzed: na khalu ārdra indhana dahana janmā dhūmaḥ kevala ārdra indhanāt vahneḥ vā jāyate atha astu evam pṛthagjana jñāneṣu bhagavat jñānam tu tad vilakṣaṇam iti asahāyam eva viśvasmin kārye paryāptam iti ced hanta bhoḥ kim asya jñānena api svarūpa atiśayaḥ eva asya asahāyaḥ tatra tatra kārye vartsyati iti na kim cit kāryam asahāyāt ekasmāt jāyate iti ced

original: nanu sta eva kṣetrajñagatau dharmādharmau santi ca paramāṇavaḥ sahāyā iti kim asya jñānena | nājñātās te pravartanta iti tajjñānam eṣitavyam iti cet | kasmād vijñātās te na pravartante |
analyzed: nanu staḥ eva kṣetrajña gatau dharma adharmau santi ca paramāṇavaḥ sahāyāḥ iti kim asya jñānena na ajñātāḥ te pravartante iti tat jñānam eṣitavyam iti ced kasmāt vijñātāḥ te na pravartante

original: kumbhādyupāyeṣu tathānupalambhād iti cet | tarhi jñānavac cikīrṣāprayatnāv apy āstheyau | tatrāpi ca jñānaṃ sākṣāccikīrṣāviśeṣa upayujyate | sa ca prayatnabhede iti prayatna eva sākṣātkāryotpādahetur iti kathaṃ tam antareṇa tatsambhavaḥ |
analyzed: kumbha ādi upāyeṣu tathā anupalambhāt iti ced tarhi jñāna vat cikīrṣā prayatnau api āstheyau tatra api ca jñānam sākṣāt cikīrṣā viśeṣaḥ upayujyate sa ca prayatna bhede iti prayatnaḥ eva sākṣātkārya utpāda hetuḥ iti katham tam antareṇa tad sambhavaḥ

original: na hi vahnim antareṇa pracurataradārusaṅghaṭṭamātrād vaṭaveṭikāspuṭasphuratphūtkāramārutamātrād vā sidhyaty odanaḥ | tasmād aṣṭaguṇādhikaraṇam eveśvaro 'taḥ sidhyatu tad api na sādhīyaḥ | yato 'syecchāprayatnau nityāv anityau vā syātām | nityau cet, kṛtam īśvarasya jñānena cikīrṣāprayatnānupayoginā | tayor anityatayā svotpādopayogān apekṣaṇāt |
analyzed: na hi vahnim antareṇa pracuratara dāru saṅghaṭṭa mātrāt vaṭa veṭikā spuṭa sphurat phūtkāra māruta mātrāt vā sidhyati odanaḥ tasmāt aṣṭaguṇa adhikaraṇam sidhyatu tat api na sādhīyaḥ yatas sya icchā prayatnau nityau anityau vā syātām nityau ced kṛtam īśvarasya jñānena cikīrṣā prayatna anupayoginā tayoḥ anitya tayā sva utpāda upayogān apekṣaṇāt

original: na ca praytnavad asya jñānam api sākṣātkāryotpādanāṅgam | prayatnabhede tathaiva khalv ayam adhitiṣṭhaty upādānādi na tu tatsamaye jñānasya kasya cid upayogaś cikīrṣāyā vā | niṣpāditakriye karmaṇy aviśeṣādhāyinaḥ sādhanasya sādhananyāyād iti dattajalāñjalir īśvarasya sarvajñatā | uktaṃ caitat prāg eva | athānityau tau |
analyzed: na ca praytna vat asya jñānam api sākṣātkārya utpādana aṅgam prayatna bhede tathā eva khalu ayam adhitiṣṭhati upādāna ādi na tu tad samaye jñānasya kasya cid upayogaḥ cikīrṣāyāḥ vā niṣpādita kriye karmaṇi aviśeṣa ādhāyinaḥ sādhanasya sādhana nyāyāt iti datta jalāñjaliḥ īśvarasya sarvajña tā uktam ca etat prāk eva atha anityau tau

original: tarhi tayor utpattikāraṇaṃ vaktavyam | nanu nityajñānam evotpattimūlakāraṇam asti tat kim apareṇa kāraṇeneti cet | aho bata pramādaḥ, yad ayam ātmamanaḥsaṃyogaviśeṣāsamavāyikāraṇāv icchāprayatnau tam antareṇa jñānamātrād eva bhavati ity api vaktum adhyavasitaḥ | tathā saty ayam ataṇḍulam api maṇṣaṃ sādhayed eva |
analyzed: tarhi tayoḥ utpatti kāraṇam vaktavyam nanu nitya jñānam eva utpatti mūla kāraṇam asti tat kim apareṇa kāraṇena iti ced aho bata pramādaḥ yat ayam ātma manaḥ saṃyoga viśeṣa asamavāyi kāraṇau icchā prayatnau tam antareṇa jñāna mātrāt eva bhavati iti api vaktum adhyavasitaḥ tathā sati ayam ataṇḍulam api maṇṣam sādhayet eva

original: santy evāsya muktātmamanobhiḥ saṃyogās tena tatsahāyas tatra tatra cikīrṣāprayatnāv ayaṃ yugapatprasūte tatkāryopajananāyeti cet | nanu manāṃsi tatsaṃyogāś ca kim anadhiṣṭhitāni cikīrṣāprayatnau prastuvāte adhiṣṭhitāni vā | yady anadhiṣṭhitāni | tadaitābhyām eva cikīrṣāprayatnābhyāṃ kāryatvahetor vyabhicāraḥ |
analyzed: santi eva asya mukta ātma manobhiḥ saṃyogāḥ tena tad sahāyaḥ tatra tatra cikīrṣā prayatnau ayam yugapad prasūte tad kārya upajananāya iti ced nanu manāṃsi tad saṃyogāḥ ca kim anadhiṣṭhitāni cikīrṣā prayatnau prastuvāte adhiṣṭhitāni vā yadi anadhiṣṭhitāni tadā etābhyām eva cikīrṣā prayatnābhyām kārya tva hetoḥ vyabhicāraḥ

original: adhiṣṭhānaṃ tu prayatnam antareṇāyuktam eva | prayatnāntareṇa cikīrṣāntarajanmanā tadadhiṣṭhānam | na cānavasthā | abhyupagamanatvāc cikīrṣāprayatnapravāhasyeti cet |
analyzed: adhiṣṭhānam tu prayatnam antareṇa ayuktam eva prayatna antareṇa cikīrṣā antara janmanā tat adhiṣṭhānam na ca anavasthā abhyupagamana tvāt cikīrṣā prayatna pravāhasya iti ced

original: nanv ayam utpannasañjihīrṣa īśvaraḥ kṣetrajñeṣu pratibaddhavṛttidharmādharmanicayeṣu jagati ca paramāṇvavasthām āpanne nirvyāpāraḥ kiyantam api kālaṃ sthitvā yadā cikīrṣati prayatate ca tadāsya cikīrṣāprayatnayor janayitavyayor na pūrvāvasthitaṃ cikīrṣāntaraṃ prayatnāntaraṃ vā samastīti kuto manasāṃ tatsaṃyogānāṃ cādhiṣṭhānam iti cet
analyzed: nanu ayam utpanna sañjihīrṣaḥ īśvaraḥ kṣetrajñeṣu pratibaddha vṛtti dharma adharma nicayeṣu jagati ca paramāṇu avasthām āpanne nirvyāpāraḥ kiyantam api kālam sthitvā yadā cikīrṣati prayatate ca tadā asya cikīrṣā prayatnayoḥ janayitavyayoḥ na pūrva avasthitam cikīrṣā antaram prayatna antaram vā samasti iti kutas manasām tad saṃyogānām ca adhiṣṭhānam iti ced

original: anānadhiṣṭhitebhyo manas tatsaṃyogebhyo na cikīrṣāprayatnāv utpādyeyātām utpadyamānau vā kathaṃ kāryatvaṃ hetuṃ na vyabhicārayataḥ | kiṃ ca śarīram api kartṛvyāpakam ity uktam | na cāsya tad astīti katham asau kartā syāt |
analyzed: an anadhiṣṭhitebhyaḥ manaḥ tad saṃyogebhyaḥ na cikīrṣā prayatnau utpādyeyātām utpadyamānau vā katham kārya tvam hetum na vyabhicārayataḥ kim ca śarīram api kartṛ vyāpakam iti uktam na ca asya tat asti iti katham asau kartā syāt

original: asty evāsya śarīram iti śaṅkaraḥ | nanu tan nityam anityaṃ vā | nityaṃ cet, niravayavaṃ sāvayavaṃ vā | na tāvan niravayavam | tad dhi pārthivaparamāṇvādinityadravyebhyo 'nyatarat svatantraṃ vā | na ca svatantram | dravyasaṅkhyākṣayaprasaṅgāt | pārthivaparamāṇvādinityadravyebhyo 'nyatarad api vyāpakam avyāpakaṃ vā |
analyzed: asti eva asya śarīram iti śaṅkaraḥ nanu tat nityam anityam vā nityam ced niravayavam sāvayavam vā na tāvat niravayavam tat dhi pārthiva paramāṇu ādi nitya dravyebhyaḥ nyatarat svatantram vā na ca svatantram dravya saṅkhyā kṣaya prasaṅgāt pārthiva paramāṇu ādi nitya dravyebhyaḥ nyatarat api vyāpakam a vyāpakam vā

original: na vyāpakam, asyeśvareṇādhiṣṭhānavirodhāt | avyāpakam api na manaḥ  tasya pratiniyatātmasambandhitvāt | pṛthivyādiparamāṇurūpatā tu tasya kathaṃ niścīyate | tadārabdhasya pṛthivyādikāryadravyasya kasya cid abhāvāt | nāpi sāvayavaṃ taccharīram | sāvayavasya nityatvavirodhāt | nāpy anityam | yatas tadbuddhimaddhetukam itarad vā | na tāvad itarat |
analyzed: na vyāpakam asya īśvareṇa adhiṣṭhāna virodhāt avyāpakam api na manaḥ tasya pratiniyata ātma sambandhi tvāt pṛthivī ādi paramāṇu rūpatā tu tasya katham niścīyate tad ārabdhasya pṛthivī ādi kārya dravyasya kasya cid abhāvāt nā api sa avayavam tat śarīram sa avayavasya nitya tva virodhāt nā api anityam yatas tat buddhimat hetukam itarat vā na tāvat itarat

original: kāryatvasya tenaiva vyabhicārāpatteḥ | buddhimaddhetukam apy anyakartṛkaṃ svakartṛkaṃ vā | yady anyakartṛkam | tadāsāv api saśarīro 'śarīro vetyādy āvarteta | tathā ceśvarānantyaprasaktiḥ | atha bhavatv iyam utsavāyaivāsmākam | eko 'pi hi bhagavān durlabha āsīd idānīm ānantyaṃ teṣāṃ kva labhyate | tad apy āpātadarśino vacaḥ |
analyzed: kāryatvasya tena eva vyabhicāra āpatteḥ buddhimat hetukam api anya kartṛkam sva kartṛkam vā yadi anya kartṛkam tadā asau api āvarteta tathā ca īśvara ānantya prasaktiḥ atha bhavatu iyam utsavāya eva asmākam ekaḥ hi bhagavān durlabhaḥ āsīt idānīm ānantyam teṣām kva labhyate tat api āpāta darśinaḥ vacaḥ

original: bahūnāṃ vyāhatamanasāṃ vyāpāre pṛthivīpramukhakāryasyānutpādaprasaṅgāt | utpannasyāpi vā vividheśvarasya vaśād asāmañjasyāpatteḥ | svakartṛkatve 'pi tad api śarīraṃ śarīrī karoty aśarīrī vā | aśarīrī cet, tathaiva trailokyam apy aśarīrīśvaro racayatu | śarīrī cet, tadā taccharīraniṣpādanāya prathamaṃ tena śarīrāntaram āracanīyam |
analyzed: bahūnām vyāhata manasām vyāpāre pṛthivī pramukha kāryasya anutpāda prasaṅgāt utpannasya api vā vividha īśvarasya vaśāt asāmañjasya āpatteḥ sva kartṛka tve tat api śarīram śarīrī karoti aśarīrī vā aśarīrī ced tathā eva trailokyam api aśarīri īśvaraḥ racayatu śarīrī ced tadā tad śarīra niṣpādanāya prathamam tena śarīra antaram āracanīyam

original: tasyāpi niṣpādanārthaṃ prathamataraṃ śarīrāntaraṃ karaṇīyam evaṃ cānavasthā syāt | tathā cāparāparaśarīranirmāṇa evopakṣīṇaśaktikatvān na kadā cit prakṛtam asau kāryaṃ kuryāt | atha syād anavasthā doṣāya yady aśarīro 'sau kāryakaraṇāya tatkāla eva svaśarīram ārabhate yāvatā sadaivāsya śarīram asty eva |
analyzed: tasya api niṣpādana artham prathamataram śarīra antaram karaṇīyam evam ca anavasthā syāt tathā ca apara apara śarīra nirmāṇe eva upakṣīṇa śaktika tvāt na kadā cid prakṛtam asau kāryam kuryāt atha syāt anavasthā doṣāya yadi aśarīraḥ sau kārya karaṇāya tad kāle eva sva śarīram ārabhate yāvatā sadā eva asya śarīram asti eva

original: kāryakālabhāvi khalu śarīraṃ prāktanaśarīrasahitena nirmitaṃ tad api prāktanataraśarīrasahitenaivety anavasthāpīyaṃ na doṣāya jāyate | bījāṅgurādivad anāditvāc charīrasantānasya | tathā cāhur mūlakṣatikarīm āhur ityādi | tad apy apūtam | adṛṣṭasaṇṭaṅkaghaṭitatvāt sarvatra śarīranāśotpādayoḥ |
analyzed: kārya kāla bhāvi khalu śarīram prāktana śarīra sahitena nirmitam tat api prāktanatara śarīra sahitena eva iti anavasthā api iyam na doṣāya jāyate bīja aṅgurā ādi vat anādi tvāt śarīra santānasya tathā ca āhuḥ mūla kṣati karīm āhuḥ ityādi tat api a pūtam adṛṣṭa saṇṭaṅka ghaṭita tvāt sarvatra śarīra nāśa utpādayoḥ

original: yena hi yāvad āyuḥkarma pūrvam upārjitaṃ bhavati tasya tāvat kālaṃ śarīram avatiṣṭhate | yādṛśaṃ ca tadbhāve tadupārjitaṃ bhavati tadanurūpeṇottarabhave tadupajāyata iti yuktam asmāddṛśeṣu sarvam | īśvare tu nāsti taditaratra muktātmanīva kautaskutī tatkalpanā | athāsty evātrecchā bhagavatī tadvaśāt tan nāśotpādau bhaviṣyata iti cet, naivam |
analyzed: yena hi yāvat āyuḥ karma pūrvam upārjitam bhavati tasya tāvat kālam śarīram avatiṣṭhate yādṛśam ca tad bhāve tat upārjitam bhavati tad anurūpeṇa uttara bhave tat upajāyate iti yuktam asmāddṛśeṣu sarvam īśvare tu nā asti tat itaratra mukta ātmani iva kautaskutī tad kalpanā atha asti eva atra icchā bhagavatī tad vaśāt tat nāśa utpādau bhaviṣyataḥ iti ced nā evam

original: asyā apy adṛṣṭāpekṣayaivātra sarvatra pravartanāt | anyathā kṛtaṃ sarvatrādṛṣṭakalpanayā | yathā yathā sthāṇor icchā pravartate tathā tathā prāṇināṃ sukhaduḥkhopabhogasya sambhavāt | tato nāsya śarīram api ghaṭata iti katham īśvararūpaviśeṣasya pakṣadharmatābalāt siddhiḥ |
analyzed: asyāḥ api adṛṣṭa apekṣayā eva atra sarvatra pravartanāt anyathā kṛtam sarvatra adṛṣṭa kalpanayā yathā yathā sthāṇoḥ icchā pravartate tathā tathā prāṇinām sukha duḥkha upabhogasya sambhavāt tatas na asya śarīram api ghaṭate iti katham īśvara rūpa viśeṣasya pakṣa dharmatā balāt siddhiḥ

original: nanv asati viśeṣe buddhimattvasāmānyasyānumānikasya tarhi kā gatir iti cet | tat kim avaśyaṃ bhavitavyam asya gatyā | nanu pramāṇasiddham upapādanīyam iti cet | yasya nāmānupapadyamānenopapādanaṃ tasya ca varam anupapattir ivāstu | nanu pramāṇasiddham anupapannam iti viruddham | evaṃ tarhi pramāṇasiddhipratighāta evāstv avirodhāya |
analyzed: nanu asati viśeṣe buddhimat tva sāmānyasya ānumānikasya tarhi kā gatiḥ iti ced tat kim avaśyam bhavitavyam asya gatyā nanu pramāṇa siddham upapādanīyam iti ced yasya nāma anupapadyamānena upapādanam tasya ca varam anupapattiḥ iva astu nanu pramāṇa siddham anupapannam iti viruddham evam tarhi pramāṇa siddhi pratighātaḥ eva astu avirodhāya

original: na punar anupapannasyopapattiḥ | kathaṃ tarhi sādhanasyedaṃ dūṣāṇam | nedaṃ sādhanasya dūṣanam | kiṃ tu vādino yogasya | yau hi jñānamātropetatvanityānityecchāprayatnopetatvasaśarīrāśarīratvādiviśeṣaparihāṇyā gaganakusumāyamāne kṣityādivartini buddhimatpūrvakatvasāmānye sādhanānarhe sādhanaṃ yojayati |
analyzed: na punar anupapannasya upapattiḥ katham tarhi sādhanasya idam dūṣāṇam na idam sādhanasya dūṣanam kim tu vādinaḥ yogasya yau hi jñāna mātra upeta tva nitya anitya icchā prayatna upeta tva sa śarīra aśarīra tva ādi viśeṣa parihāṇyā gaganakusumāyamāne kṣiti ādi vartini buddhimat pūrvakatva sāmānye sādhana anarhe sādhanam yojayati

original: na ca sambhavati tādṛśo viśeṣaḥ | yam āsthāya kṣityādau buddhimatpūrvakatvasāmānyaṃ vyavatiṣṭheta | na caivaṃ sarvānumānocchedaprasaṅgaḥ | sambhavadviśeṣaviṣayatvād itareṣām anumānānām | na hi na sambhavati parvatanitambavaaaartī bahirviśeṣaḥ |
analyzed: na ca sambhavati tādṛśaḥ viśeṣaḥ yam āsthāya kṣiti ādau buddhimat pūrvakatva sāmānyam vyavatiṣṭheta na ca evam sarva anumāna uccheda prasaṅgaḥ sambhavat viśeṣa viṣaya tvāt itareṣām anumānānām na hi na sambhavati bahis viśeṣaḥ

original: tasmād yathā kaś cin niśāntamasimacchadyemākāśaṃ prati vyāpārayan puruṣo nigṛhyate, na punar asirākāśaṃ va | tadvat kāryatvam apīśvara iti | yac ca pakāladharmatāsamarthanāprastāva evoktam | ye hi yat kartāras te tadupādānādyabhijñāḥ | yathā kulālādayaḥ | sarveṣāṃ ca kāryāṇām īśvaraḥ kartreti | tad apy ayuktam |

original: yataḥ kim ete kulālllasayaḥ svakāryasya niravaśeṣopādānopakaraṇādivedihaḥ katipayopādānopakaraṇādivedino vā | nādyaḥ pakṣaḥ | adṛṣṭasya sasrvotpattimatāṃ nimittahetor upakaraḥasāparijñānāt | nāpi sampradānaprayijanaviśeṣavedinaḥ | tasya sampradānabhedasya devadattādeḥ praayijanabhedasya ca madhūdakadhāraṇāder anekasyāpi sambhavāt |
analyzed: yatas kim ete sva kāryasya niravaśeṣa upādāna upakaraṇa ādi vedi haḥ katipaya upādāna upakaraṇa ādi vedinaḥ vā na ādyaḥ pakṣaḥ adṛṣṭasya sa srva utpattimatām nimitta hetoḥ upakaraḥ asā parijñānāt na api sampradāna prayi jana viśeṣa vedinaḥ tasya sampradāna bhedasya devadatta ādeḥ praayi jana bhedasya ca madhu udaka dhāraṇa ādeḥ anekasya api sambhavāt

original: athopādānopakaraṇādimātrravijñānaṃ na samasdtopādānopakaraṇajñānaṃ kulālllllādīnām | tarhi tenaiva nidarśaneneśvarasyāpi tadupakaraṇamātrajñānaṃ syāt | tanmāṭrajñāne ca sarajñatāsiddheḥ | katipayajño hi tathā sati syāt | atha conmattādivattāvanmatrajñānam apīśvarasya na sidhyati | tathā hi |
analyzed: atha upādāna upakaraṇa ādi mātrra vijñānam na samasdta upādāna upakaraṇa jñānam tarhi tena eva nidarśanena īśvarasya api tad upakaraṇa mātra jñānam syāt tad māṭra jñāne ca katipaya jñaḥ hi tathā sati syāt atha ca unmatta ādi vat tāvat matra jñānam api īśvarasya na sidhyati tathā hi

original: kṛtrimamaṇimaukikādau khātaprapūrativasundharāyāṃ vākṛtrimamaṇimauktikabhūbhāgādisaṃsthānasārūpyasya kṛtrimabuddher anutpādakasya sadbhāvatas tadanutpādasyopapatteḥ na ca bhūbhūdharādāv apy akṛtakasaṃsthānasādṛśyaṃ sambhavati |
analyzed: kṛtrima maṇi maukika ādau khāta prapūrati vasundharāyām vā akṛtrima maṇi mauktika bhū bhāga ādi saṃsthāna sārūpyasya kṛtrima buddheḥ anutpādakasya sadbhāvataḥ tad anutpādasya upapatteḥ na ca bhū bhūdhara ādau api akṛtaka saṃsthāna sādṛśyam sambhavati

original: akṛtakasaṃsthānasyaiva tvayānaṅgīkārāt | yat punar uktam | ko 'yaṃ kāryatvasya viśeṣaḥ | kiṃ buddhimadanvayavyatirekānuvidhānaṃ taddarśanaṃ vetyādi ca | tatrāyam eva kāryatvasya viśeṣo  buddhimatā svabhāvapratibaddho 'bhidhīyate | yaḥ khalv akriyādarśino 'pi kṛtabuddhim ātmani janayati | proktaś cāyam arthaḥ prāg eva |
analyzed: akṛtaka saṃsthānasya eva tvayā anaṅgīkārāt yat punar uktam kaḥ yam kāryatvasya viśeṣaḥ kim buddhimat anvaya vyatireka anuvidhānam tad darśanam vā ityādi ca tatra ayam eva kāryatvasya viśeṣaḥ buddhimatā svabhāva pratibaddhaḥ bhidhīyate yaḥ khalu kṛtabuddhim ātmani janayati proktaḥ ca ayam arthaḥ prāk eva

original: yad apy uktam ekatvaṃ ca kṣityādikartur ityādi | tad api nāvadātam |  buddhimataḥ sādhyasyaikatvaniyame niścayābhāvāt | ekatvena hi tasya siddhir nityatvavibhutvasarvajñatvasiddhau syāt | tathā ceśvaravyavahārabhājanam asau syāt | na ca nityatvādisiddhiḥ sambhāvyate |
analyzed: yat api uktam ekatvam ca kṣiti ādi kartuḥ ityādi tat api na avadātam buddhimataḥ sādhyasya eka tva niyame niścaya abhāvāt ekatvena hi tasya siddhiḥ nitya tva vibhu tva sarvajña tva siddhau syāt tathā ca īśvara vyavahāra bhājanam asau syāt na ca nitya tva ādi siddhiḥ sambhāvyate

original: bhinnadeśakālakalitaṃ hi kāryajātam anekena saṅkhyātikrāntena kartrā kṛtaṃ sambhāvyate | tathā ca sati na tāvad vibhutvanityatve | anekasya ca kartuḥ svasvaviṣayopādānādimātravedanasiddhau kva sarvajñatvam | atha bahūnāṃ vyāhatamanasāṃ vyāpāre kāryam eva notpadyate |
analyzed: bhinna deśa kāla kalitam hi kārya jātam anekena saṅkhyā atikrāntena kartrā kṛtam sambhāvyate tathā ca sati na tāvat vibhu tva nitya tve anekasya ca kartuḥ sva sva viṣaya upādāna ādi mātra vedana siddhau kva sarvajñatvam atha bahūnām vyāhata manasām vyāpāre kāryam eva nā utpadyate

original: utpannam api vā sapadi vipadyeteti pratikalam utpattivipattimātravyāpārā varākī  trilokī kathaṃ kām apy arthakriyāṃ kuryād iti cet | tad acaturasram | pratyekaṃ hi vaibhavādiguṇayogādīśvarādīnāṃ vyāpāre syād apīyam āśaṅkā | yāvatā sāmpratam eko 'pi tādṛṅ na sidhyatīty ucyate |
analyzed: utpannam api vā sapadi vipadyeta iti pratikalam utpatti vipatti mātra vyāpārā varākī trilokī katham kām api arthakriyām kuryāt iti ced tat acaturasram pratyekam hi vaibhava ādi guṇa yogāt īśvara ādīnām vyāpāre syāt api iyam āśaṅkā yāvatā sāmpratam ekaḥ pi tādṛś na sidhyati iti ucyate

original: arvācīnaśaktayaś ca bhūyāṃsa ekam anekaṃ vā kāryam ārabhya niṣpādayanto dṛśyanta eva | nanu naikatrāpi pradhānabhūtenaikena bhavitavyam, balīyasā vā, sūtradhāravat senānīvad vā | atas tasyaiva kartṛtvam itareṣāṃ tadanuvartitvād iti cet | na tatrāpi niyamābhāvāt | svasvaprayojanānurodhena svatantrāṇām api keṣāṃ cid ekasattvādighaṭanadarśanāt |
analyzed: arvācīna śaktayaḥ ca bhūyāṃsaḥ ekam anekam vā kāryam ārabhya niṣpādayantaḥ dṛśyante eva nanu na ekatra api pradhāna bhūtena ekena bhavitavyam balīyasā vā sūtradhāra vat senānī vat vā atas tasya eva kartṛ tvam itareṣām tad anuvarti tvāt iti ced na tatra api niyama abhāvāt sva sva prayojana anurodhena svatantrāṇām api keṣām cid eka sattva ādi ghaṭana darśanāt

original: tatrāpi kaś cid eva prathamaprayojaka ity api nāsti | anekasyāpi tathā hṛdayotkalitakāryānivāraṇāt | nīcasyāpi vā prayojakatvasambhavāt | tasmāt bhramaramadhumakṣikāpipīlikādibhir madhukṣatravālmīkādivat kṣudraprāṇibhir apy ekaikamainākakailāśādikaraṇasambhāvanāyāṃ kā vārttā viśvasyaikena kriyāyāḥ |
analyzed: tatra api kaḥ cit eva prathama prayojakaḥ iti api nā asti anekasya api tathā hṛdaya utkalita kārya anivāraṇāt nīcasya api vā prayojaka tva sambhavāt tasmāt bhramara madhu makṣikā pipīlika ādibhiḥ madhukṣatra vālmīka ādi vat kṣudra prāṇibhiḥ api ekaika maināka kailāśa ādi karaṇa sambhāvanāyām kā vārttā viśvasya ekena kriyāyāḥ

original: tatrādrṣṭajanmānas tāvat kṛtacetanānumitayaḥ kṣitidharādayas tāvataiva kṛtārthāḥ |
analyzed: tatra adrṣṭa janmānaḥ tāvat kṛta cetanā anumitayaḥ kṣitidhara ādayaḥ tāvatā eva kṛtārthāḥ

original: te ca tatkartṛjantava upādānam atikṣudrapṛthivyādidravyam upakaraṇaṃ mukhādi sampradānam ātmānam eva prayojanam ātmanaḥ sthitisukhādi jānanta eva valmīkajantuvat pravarteran | siddhe ca nāvaśam adhiṣṭhāyakaṃ dṛśyeran svabhāvaviprakarṣāt | ye 'pi dṛṣṭajanmāno vṛkṣādayaḥ pauruṣeyāḥ | tatra cintaiva nāsti |
analyzed: te ca tad kartṛ jantavaḥ upādānam ati kṣudra pṛthivī ādi dravyam upakaraṇam mukha ādi sampradānam ātmānam eva prayojanam ātmanaḥ sthiti sukha ādi jānantaḥ eva valmīka jantu vat pravarteran siddhe ca na avaśam adhiṣṭhāyakam dṛśyeran svabhāva viprakarṣāt ye pi dṛṣṭa janmānaḥ vṛkṣa ādayaḥ pauruṣeyāḥ tatra cintā eva na asti

original: adṛṣṭapuruṣavyāpārās tu ye vindhyādiparisarabhuvaḥ te 'pi piśācādiprakārair adhiṣṭhātṛbhir asaṅkhyaiḥ kartṛmanta iti kaḥ sarvavedī bhavatu | te cādhiṣṭhātāro deśakālayor bhinnā eveti kuto vibhutvanityatve | na caivaṃ śaṅkāyā virodhakaṃ kiṃ cid asti vastubalapravṛttam anumānam |

original: nanu caivaṃ bhavadbhir api na svīkṛtam eva, etāvac cātikaṣṭataraṃ kalpayatāṃ varam īśvarakalpanaiva lāghavād iti cet | satyam | yadi kalpanāmātre bharanyāsas tadā bhavadupadeśam eva puraskariṣyāmaḥ | yāvat punar anumānavyājaṃ na varjayasi | tāvad evāsmākam avaśyam atinipuṇanirūpaṇābhiyogaḥ |
analyzed: nanu ca evam bhavadbhiḥ api na svīkṛtam eva etāvat ca ati kaṣṭataram kalpayatām varam īśvara kalpanā eva lāghavāt iti ced satyam yadi kalpanā mātre bhara nyāsaḥ tadā bhavat upadeśam eva puraskariṣyāmaḥ yāvat punar anumāna vyājam na varjayasi tāvat eva asmākam avaśyam ati nipuṇa nirūpaṇa abhiyogaḥ

original: atha kṣudrair asaṅkhyair nirmitā narmadādaya iti dunoti cetaś cet | ekenāśarīreṇa nirmitās ta iti tu suṣṭhutarām | tasmāt pramāṇam eva sarvato balavad yathā sthāpayati tathārthasthitiḥ | ata etat dṛḍhaṃ nirūpyate | na ca kṣudreṣv anurodhaḥ kaś cit |

original: vācaspatinā kāryatānumānāt kasya cit tanubhuvanādyabhijñatāṃ prasādhya sarvajñatāsiddhaye pariśeṣānumānaṃ vyatirekāparaparyāyam udyate | tanubhuvanādyupādānādyabhijñaḥ kartā nānityāsarvaviṣayabuddhimān | tatkartus tadupādānādyanabhijñatvaprasaṅgāt | na hy evaṃvidhas tadupādānādyabhijño dṛṣṭo yathāsmadādiḥ | tadupādānādyabhijñaś cāyam |

original: tan na prakṛtiparatantro 'pi tryakṣaḥ sarvakāryakārī | kartṛtvābhyupagame vāsya akartā nirguṇaḥ śuddhaḥ ityāder ātmalakṣaṇasyānupapattiḥ | athānyātmanām evaitallakṣaṇaṃ neśvarasya, tasya tebhyo viśiṣṭatvāt tenāyam adoṣa iti | nanv evaṃ śuddhatvāder apāśvarasvarūpatvābhāvaprasaṅgād atīva tasya tebhyo viśiṣṭatvaṃ syāt |

original: na khalu buddhipariṇāmasyaiśvaryasyāsambhave tato 'rthāntarabhūtasya bhūtapates tad yuktam | anyātmano 'pi tatprasakteḥ | atha pramathādhipater buddhyā saha sambandhāt tasyaiva tannānyasyety ucyate | nanu ko 'yam īśvareṇa kālaṃ buddheḥ sambandhaḥ, samavāyaḥ saṃyogādir īśvaroddeśena pravṛttimātraṃ vā | na tāvat samavāyaḥ |
analyzed: na khalu buddhi pariṇāmasya aiśvaryasya asambhave tatas ṛtha antara bhūtasya bhūtapateḥ tat yuktam tad prasakteḥ atha pramatha adhipateḥ buddhyā saha sambandhāt tasya eva tat na anyasya iti ucyate nanu kaḥ yam īśvareṇa kālam buddheḥ sambandhaḥ samavāyaḥ saṃyoga ādiḥ īśvara uddeśena pravṛtti mātram vā na tāvat samavāyaḥ

original: anyadharmasyānyatrānupapatteḥ | yo yaddharmaḥ sa tato 'nyatra na samavaiti | yathā cidrūpatā puruṣasya | prakṛtidharmaś ca buddhiḥ | tasmāt tato 'rthāntaraśambhau na samavaitīti | na ca sphaṭikādisamavetena śoṇimādidharmeṇānaikāntaḥ | japāpuśpasannidhāne sphaṭikāder eva tathā pariṇamanāt |
analyzed: anya dharmasya anyatra anupapatteḥ yaḥ yad dharmaḥ sa tatas nyatra na samavaiti yathā cit rūpa tā puruṣasya prakṛti dharmaḥ ca buddhiḥ tasmāt tatas ṛtha antara śambhau na samavaiti iti na ca sphaṭika ādi samavetena śoṇima ādi dharmeṇa an aikāntaḥ japā puśpa sannidhāne sphaṭika ādeḥ eva tathā pariṇamanāt

original: etac ca pratibandhodayāvicārāvasare savistaram upapādayiṣyate | ātmano 'pi buddhirūpatayā pariṇate prakṛtisannidhāne tathā pariṇāmāṅgīkāre vicchaktir apariṇāminī, apratisaṅkramety abhyupagamavirodhaḥ | tan neśvareṇa saha buddheḥ samavāyalakṣāṇaḥ sambandho yujyate | nāpi saṃyogasvarūpaḥ | buddher adravyatvāt | atiprasaṅgāc ca |
analyzed: etat ca pratibandha udaya avicāra avasare sa vistaram upapādayiṣyate ātmanaḥ api buddhi rūpa tayā pariṇate prakṛti sannidhāne tathā pariṇāma aṅgīkāre vicchaktiḥ apariṇāminī apratisaṅkramā iti abhyupagama virodhaḥ tat na īśvareṇa saha buddheḥ samavāya lakṣāṇaḥ sambandhaḥ yujyate nā api saṃyoga sva rūpaḥ buddheḥ adravya tvāt atiprasaṅgāt ca

original: sarvair apy ātmabhir nityavyāpibhir buddheḥ saṃyogo vidyata eva | etena saṃyuktasamavāyādir api prativyūḍhaḥ | asambhavasyātiprasaṅgasyātrāpy aviśeṣāt | atheśvaroddeśena pravṛttimātram evāsyās tena sambandhaḥ | tad apy asādhu | īśvaroddeśenāsyāḥ pravṛtter asambhavāt |

original: asātānubhavatvāt pratibaddhavedanīyakarmaprabhavasyāyogyavasthācaramakṣaṇaṃ yāvatsaṃbhavāt | avikalakāraṇasya kāryasyotpatter anivāraṇāt, anyathā tasya tatkāraṇatvāyogāt | na ca dagdharajjusaṃsthānīyatvād asātāvedanīyasya svakāryājanakatvam iti vācyam | tata eva sātāvedanīyasyāpi svakāryājanakatvāpatteḥ sukhānubhavasyāpi bhagavaty abhāvaprasaṅgāt |
analyzed: asāta anubhava tvāt pratibaddha vedanīya karma prabhavasya ayogi avasthā carama kṣaṇam yāvat saṃbhavāt avikala kāraṇasya kāryasya utpatteḥ anivāraṇāt anyathā tasya tad kāraṇa tva ayogāt na ca dagdha rajju saṃsthānīya tvāt asāta vedanīyasya sva kārya ajanaka tvam iti vācyam tatas eva sāta vedanīyasya api sva kārya ajanaka tva āpatteḥ sukha anubhavasya api bhagavati abhāva prasaṅgāt

original: yathā ca dagdharajjusaṃsthānīyāyuṣkakarmodayakāryaprāṇādidhāraṇaṃ bhavati tathā prakṛtam abhyupagamyatām | viśeṣābhāvāt |
analyzed: yathā ca dagdha rajju saṃsthānīya āyuṣka karma udaya kārya prāṇa ādi dhāraṇam bhavati tathā prakṛtam abhyupagamyatām viśeṣa abhāvāt

original: kiṃ caikādaśajina iti sūtrāt kṣudādipariṣahaikādaśakasya duḥkharūpasya kevalini siddheḥ kathaṃ duḥkharūpāyā bubhukṣāyās tatra na siddhiḥ |
analyzed: kim ca ekādaśa jine iti sūtrāt kṣudh ādi pariṣaha ekādaśakasya duḥkha rūpasya kevalini siddheḥ katham duḥkha rūpāyāḥ bubhukṣāyāḥ tatra na siddhiḥ

original: prabhācandras tu chadmasthavītarāgayoś caturdaśeti bādarasamparāye sarve iti ca pūrvāparaparigatāṃ sūtradvayīṃ vidhiparāṃ parāmṛśatāntarālikaṃ tv ekādaśajina iti sūtraṃ niṣedhaniṣṭhaṃ niṣṭaṅkayitum ekādaśaśabdasyaikādhikadaśasvarūpaṃ prasiddhaṃ sambhavinaṃ cārtham avagaṇayyaikādaśajine ity āgamo 'pi kṣudādyekādaśaparīṣahapratiṣedhaparaḥ
analyzed: prabhācandraḥ tu chadma sthavīta rāgayoḥ caturdaśa iti bādara samparāye sarve iti ca pūrva apara parigatām sūtra dvayīm vidhi parām parāmṛśatā antarālikam tu ekādaśa jine iti sūtram niṣedha niṣṭham niṣṭaṅkayitum ekādaśa śabdasya eka adhika daśa svarūpam prasiddham sambhavinam ca artham avagaṇayya ekādaśa jine iti kṣudh ādi ekādaśa parīṣaha pratiṣedha paraḥ

original: pratipattavyaḥ | ekenādhikā na daśa ekādaśa iti vyutpatter ity evamarthaṃ parikalpayan niyataṃ loko yāni prasiddhāni padāni tāni sati sambhave tadarthāny eva sūtreṣv ity avagantavyaṃ nādhyāhārādibhir eṣāṃ parikalpanīyo 'rthaḥ paribhāṣitavyo veti sakalakalāvidviditam api nyāyaṃ na kadā cid aśrauṣīt |
analyzed: pratipattavyaḥ ekena adhikāḥ na daśa ekādaśaḥ iti vyutpatteḥ iti evam artham parikalpayan niyatam lokaḥ yāni prasiddhāni padāni tāni sati sambhave tad arthāni eva sūtreṣu iti avagantavyam na adhyāhāra ādibhiḥ eṣām parikalpanīyaḥ rthaḥ paribhāṣitavyaḥ vā iti sakala kalā vid viditam api nyāyam na kadā cid aśrauṣīt

original: ekādhikadaśasvarūpo hy arthaḥ prastutaśabdasya prasiddha eva | na cāsau na sambhavī | vedanīyodayabhāvinām ekādaśaparīṣahāṇāṃ tatra sambhavāt | athaikādhikadaśapratiṣedhalakṣaṇo 'py arthaḥ  prasiddha eveti katham asāv asya parikalpita iti cet |
analyzed: eka adhika daśa svarūpaḥ hi arthaḥ prastuta śabdasya prasiddhaḥ eva na ca asau na sambhavī vedanīya udaya bhāvinām ekādaśa parīṣahāṇām tatra sambhavāt atha eka adhika daśa pratiṣedha lakṣaṇaḥ u pi arthaḥ prasiddhaḥ eva iti katham asau asya parikalpitaḥ iti ced

original: bho bhagavantaḥ sabhyāḥ sarve 'py ākarṇayantu kṛtakarṇāḥ |
analyzed: bho bhagavantaḥ sabhyāḥ sarve pi ākarṇayantu kṛta karṇāḥ

original: ekādaśaśabdārthaḥ prakhyātaḥ kvāpi yady evam || 430 ||

original: nāpy asau sambhavī | vedanīyodayetyādinyāyasya pradarśitatvāt | api caikādaśety atra nañ daśaśabdena sambaddhaḥ paryudāsaḥ prasajyo vā bhavet | paryudāsaś cet, tadā daśasadṛśā navādaya ekādaśa ekādaśādayo vādaśaśabdavācyāḥ syuḥ |
analyzed: nā api asau sambhavī vedanīya udaya ityādi nyāyasya pradarśita tvāt api ca ekādaśa iti atra nañ daśa śabdena sambaddhaḥ paryudāsaḥ prasajyaḥ vā bhavet paryudāsaḥ ced tadā daśa sadṛśāḥ nava ādayaḥ ekādaśa ekādaśa ādayaḥ vādaśa śabda vācyāḥ syuḥ

original: tataś caikenādhikā adaśeti vigrahe daśādīnāṃ dvādaśādīnāṃ vā parīṣahāṇāṃ tatra vidhānaprasaṅgāt katham ekādāśaparīṣahapratiṣedhaparatāsya sūtrasya syāt | prasajyaś cet, tarhy adaśeti samāso na prāpnoti | tatra samāsapratiṣedhāt |
analyzed: tatas ca ekena adhikāḥ adaśa iti vigrahe daśa ādīnām dvādaśa ādīnām vā parīṣahāṇām tatra vidhāna prasaṅgāt katham ekādāśa parīṣaha pratiṣedha para tā asya sūtrasya syāt prasajyaḥ ced tarhi adaśa iti samāsaḥ na prāpnoti tatra samāsa pratiṣedhāt

original: saty api cāsminn adaśaśabdasya daśapratiṣedhamātrabodhakatāyām ekenādhikā adaśeti daśapratiṣedhasyaikaśabdena kīdṛśī saṅgatiḥ syāt | tad ayaṃ tapasvī svakīyadarśanābhiniveśavisaṃsthulīkṛtasvāntaḥ kāśakuśāvalambanair ātmānaṃ viḍambayati |
analyzed: sati api ca asmin adaśa śabdasya daśa pratiṣedha mātra bodhaka tāyām ekena adhikāḥ adaśa iti daśa pratiṣedhasya eka śabdena kīdṛśī saṅgatiḥ syāt tat ayam tapasvī svakīya darśana abhiniveśa visaṃsthulīkṛta svāntaḥ kāśa kuśa avalambanaiḥ ātmānam viḍambayati

original: yat punar ekādaśajina iti sūtravyākhyāyāṃ svayam āśaṅkitam abhinandayann idaṃ nijagāda vidyānandaḥ, tarhi jinendre kṣudādayo 'pi nābhūvan | moharahitasya vedanīyasya tatra sato 'pi tajjananāsamarthatvāt | tathāprasiddhodāsināvasthapuruṣavat | satyam etat | upacāreṇa tatra teṣām abhidhānāt |
analyzed: yat punar ekādaśa jine iti sūtra vyākhyāyām svayam āśaṅkitam abhinandayan idam nijagāda vidyānandaḥ tarhi jinendre kṣudh ādayaḥ na abhūvan moha rahitasya vedanīyasya tatra tad janana asamartha tvāt tathā a prasiddha udāsina avastha puruṣa vat satyam etat upacāreṇa tatra teṣām abhidhānāt

original: sakalārthasākṣātkāriṇo 'manas kasya cittavṛttinirodhābhāve 'pi dhyānābhidhānavat | kiṃ tadupacāranimittam iti cet, tatsāmagryekādaśavedanīyasadbhava iti | tad idaṃ sahṛdayahṛdayānām ānandaṃ manāgdadhānaṃ tadabhidhānasyāyathārthatvam eva vyañjayati |
analyzed: sakala artha sākṣātkāriṇaḥ manaḥ kasya citta vṛtti nirodha abhāve dhyāna abhidhāna vat kim tad upacāra nimittam iti ced tad sāmagrī ekādaśa vedanīya sadbhave iti tat idam sahṛdaya hṛdayānām ānandam manāk dadhānam tad abhidhānasya ayathārtha tvam eva vyañjayati

original: tatha hi tatsāmagryekādaśavedanīyasadbhāva ity amunaikādaśapraīṣahopacāranimittaṃ kevaliny āvedayato mohanīyopabṛṃhitavedanīyalakṣaṇasyaivāsyābhipretā tatsāmagrī | sā ca na kṣodakṣamā | mohanīyopabṛṃhaṇam antareṇaiva nāmādikarmaṇa iva vedyakarmaṇo 'pi kevalini svakāryakaraṇaprāvīṇyopapatteḥ |
analyzed: hi tad sāmagrī ekādaśa vedanīya sadbhāvaḥ iti amunā ekādaśa praīṣaha upacāra nimittam kevalini āvedayataḥ mohanīya upabṛṃhita vedanīya lakṣaṇasya eva asya abhipretā tad sāmagrī sā ca na kṣoda kṣamā mohanīya upabṛṃhaṇam antareṇa eva nāma ādi karmaṇaḥ iva vedya karmaṇaḥ kevalini sva kārya karaṇa prāvīṇya upapatteḥ

original: anyathā tīrthakaraṇām akarmādy api tīrthapravartanādisvasādhyasādhanāsādhīyastāṃ na dhāreyat | evaṃ copacāravacanam acaturasram | mukhyavṛttyaiva svahetuprabhavaparīṣahāṇāṃ kevaliny upapāditatvāt | upapādayiṣyate caitat purastāt | etena sarvārthasiddhir apy atropacāravyākhyānaṃ kurvan parāstaḥ |
analyzed: anyathā tīrthakaraṇām akarma ādi api tīrtha pravartana ādi sva sādhya sādhana a sādhīyaḥ tām na dhāreyat evam ca upacāra vacanam acaturasram mukhya vṛttyā eva sva hetu prabhava parīṣahāṇām kevalini upapādita tvāt upapādayiṣyate ca etat purastāt etena sarva artha siddhiḥ api atra upacāra vyākhyānam kurvan parāstaḥ

original: yad apy ayam ekaikādaśajine parīṣahā na santīty adhyāhāryam iti pakṣāntaram upakṣiptavān | tad api na sūkṣmam | prakṛtasyārthasyāpratisiddhāv asambhave vā sati hy adhyāhāraḥ kartavyo nānyathā |
analyzed: yat api ayam eka ekādaśa jine parīṣahāḥ na santi iti adhyāhāryam iti pakṣa antaram upakṣiptavān tat api na sūkṣmam prakṛtasya arthasya apratisiddhau asambhave vā sati hi adhyāhāraḥ kartavyaḥ na anyathā

original: na caivaṃ tad ihāstīti proktaṃ prāk | śarīrasthityanyathānupapattyeti dvitīyavikalpe tu yad anantavīryatvaṃ prastutāhāram antareṇāpi kevalini śarīrasthitikāraṇam ucyate | tacchadmasthāvasthāyām api tatrāparimitabalaśravaṇāt samasty eva | na ca prastutāhāraṃ vinā tat tasyām avasthāyāṃ tatra śarīrasthitikāraṇam |
analyzed: na ca evam tat iha asti iti proktam prāk śarīra sthiti anyathā anupapattyā iti dvitīya vikalpe tu yat ananta vīrya tvam prastuta āhāram antareṇa api kevalini śarīra sthiti kāraṇam ucyate tat chadmastha avasthāyām api tatra aparimita bala śravaṇāt samasti eva na ca prastuta āhāram vinā tat tasyām avasthāyām tatra śarīra sthiti kāraṇam

original: anyathā karmakṣāyārtham anaśanāditapasyudyamavato bhagavataḥ prāṇavṛttipratyayam aśanādyabhyavaharaṇam asaṅgataṃ syāt | na ca chadmasthāvasthāyāṃ kṣāyopaśamikaṃ tasya vīraṃ kevalyavasthāyāṃ tu kṣāyikam iti viśiṣṭāhāram antareṇāpi kevalyavasthāyāṃ tu tat tatra śarīrasthitinibandhanam ity abhidhānīyam |
analyzed: anyathā karma kṣāya artham anaśana ādi tapasi udyamavataḥ bhagavataḥ prāṇa vṛtti pratyayam aśana ādi abhyavaharaṇam syāt na ca chadmastha avasthāyām kṣāyopaśamikam tasya vīram kevalī avasthāyām tu kṣāyikam iti viśiṣṭa āhāram antareṇa api kevalī avasthāyām tu tat tatra śarīra sthiti nibandhanam iti abhidhānīyam

original: kṣāyikavīryasadbhāve 'pi śarīrasthitinimittopaveśanādivat prakṛtāhārasyāpy avirodhāt | na copaveśanādikam api śarīrasthityarthaṃ tatrāsiddham | samuddhātāvasthāntarakālaṃ kevalinaḥ pīṭhaphalādipratyarpaṇaśruteḥ | na ca tadgrahaṇam antareṇa tatpratyarpaṇaṃ sambhavatīti | svabhāvata ea bhukta iti tṛtīyavikalpas tv anabhyupagamād eva pratihata iti |
analyzed: kṣāyika vīrya sadbhāve pi śarīra sthiti nimitta upaveśana ādi vat prakṛta āhārasya api avirodhāt na ca upaveśana ādikam api śarīra sthiti artham tatra asiddham samuddhāta avasthā antara kālam kevalinaḥ pīṭha phala ādi pratyarpaṇa śruteḥ na ca tad grahaṇam antareṇa tad pratyarpaṇam sambhavati iti svabhāvataḥ bhuktaḥ iti tṛtīya vikalpaḥ tu anabhyupagamāt eva pratihataḥ iti

original: yac cedam ucyate,
analyzed: yat ca idam ucyate

original: kiṃ dehopacaryārtham eva yadi vā jñānādi mā kṣīyatām ity evaṃ kim atha kṣudhaḥ kṣatikṛṭe kiṃ vāyuṣo 'sādhite |
analyzed: kim deha upacarya artham eva yadi vā jñāna ādi mā kṣīyatām iti evam kim atha kṣudhaḥ kṣati kṛṭe kim sādhite

original: nirvāṇe kṣayarakṣaṇārtham atha vā gṛddhiṃ raseśūtkaṭāṃ hantuṃ lokam anugraḥitum atha kiṃ bhuṅkte jinaḥ kevalī || 433 ||
analyzed: nirvāṇe kṣaya rakṣaṇa artham atha vā gṛddhim raseśu utkaṭām hantum lokam atha kim bhuṅkte jinaḥ kevalī

original: iti, tatra dehopacaryārtham iti prathamapakṣas tāvan nābhyupagamyate | na khalu mama śarīre upacayaḥ sañjāyatām ity abhisandhāya bhagavān bhuṅkte | vītarāgatavāt | anyathā prākṛtapuruṣasyeva tasyāpi sarāgatvaprasaṅgāt | jñānādi mā kṣīyatām iti dvitīyapakṣo 'pi nāṅgīkriyate | jñānādikṣāyanibandhanābhāvād eva tatra jñānādīnām akṣayaprasiddheḥ |
analyzed: iti tatra deha upacarya artham iti prathama pakṣaḥ tāvat na abhyupagamyate na khalu mama śarīre upacayaḥ sañjāyatām iti abhisandhāya bhagavān bhuṅkte vīta rāga tavāt anyathā prākṛta puruṣasya iva tasya api sa rāga tva prasaṅgāt jñāna ādi mā kṣīyatām iti dvitīya pakṣaḥ u pi nā aṅgīkriyate jñāna ādi kṣāya nibandhana abhāvāt eva tatra jñāna ādīnām akṣaya prasiddheḥ

original: jñānādikṣayasya hi nibandhanaṃ jñānāvaraṇādikarma | tac ca prakṣīṇāśeṣāvaraṇe bhagavati nāstīti kathaṃ jñānādiprakṣayāśaṅkḥāpi | tatas tatkṣayarakṣaṇārtham api na bhuṅkte bhagavān | kṣudhaḥ kṣatikṛte bhuṅkta ity ayaṃ tu tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ kakṣīkriyata eva |
analyzed: jñāna ādi kṣayasya hi nibandhanam jñāna āvaraṇa ādi karma tat ca prakṣīṇa aśeṣa āvaraṇe bhagavati na asti iti katham jñāna ādi prakṣaya āśaṅkḥā api tatas tad kṣaya rakṣaṇa artham api na bhuṅkte bhagavān kṣudhaḥ kṣati kṛte bhuṅkte iti ayam tu tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ kakṣīkriyate eva

original: yat punar atra dūṣaṇaṃ ikpaṭaiḥ prakaṭīkriyate 'nantasukhatvena bhagavati duḥkhasyāsambhavād anupapadyamānaṃ kṣudvedanāpratīkārārthaṃ tatra bhojanam iti | tad atīvāsambaddham | anantasukhasyaiva bhavasthakevaliny asiddheḥ | sātāsātavedanīyakarmaṇaḥ sambhavena kiṃcidduḥkhānuṣaktasukhasyaiva tatraprasiddhatvāt |
analyzed: yat punar atra dūṣaṇam ikpaṭaiḥ prakaṭīkriyate nanta sukha tvena bhagavati duḥkhasya asambhavāt anupapadyamānam kṣudh vedanā pratīkāra artham tatra bhojanam iti tat atīva asambaddham ananta sukhasya eva bhava stha kevalini asiddheḥ sāta asāta vedanīya karmaṇaḥ sambhavena kiṃcid duḥkha anuṣakta sukhasya eva tatra prasiddha tvāt

original: āyuṣo 'sādhite nirvāṇe kṣayarakṣaṇārtham iti caturthapakṣo 'pi na svīkriyate | caramottamam adehānām anapavarttyāyuṣkatvād eva | anapavartanīyasyāyuṣaḥ svasthitikālasamāptiṃ vihāya kṣayānupapatteḥ | ityāyuḥkṣayarakṣaṇārtham api nāsau bhuṅkte | gṛddhiṃ raseṣūtkaṭāṃ hantum iti pañcamapakṣo 'pi nābhyupeyate |
analyzed: sādhite nirvāṇe kṣaya rakṣaṇa artham iti caturtha pakṣaḥ pi na svīkriyate carama uttamam adehānām anapavarttyāyuṣka tvāt eva anapavartanīyasya āyuṣaḥ sva sthiti kāla samāptim vihāya kṣaya anupapatteḥ iti āyuḥ kṣaya rakṣaṇa artham api na asau bhuṅkte gṛddhim raseṣu utkaṭām hantum iti pañcama pakṣaḥ pi na abhyupeyate

original: vītamohe bhagavati rasagṛddhimātrasyāpy anupapatteḥ | lokam anugrahītuṃ bhuṅkte | iti ṣaṣṭhapakṣo 'pi norarīkriyate | na khalu lokam anugṛhnāṃīti abhisandhipurassaram āhāram abhyavaharati bhagavān | lokānugrahe tu sāmānyakevalinaḥ svakīyāsādhāraṇanaṃ akarmanirmitaṃ tatsvābhāvyanimittā pravṛttiḥ |

original: kāraṇamātrasya kāryābhāve 'pi bhāvāvirodhāt | kāraṇam api nivartamānaṃ āryaṃ nivartayati. yathā vahnir dhūmam | vyāpakaṃ vā nivartamānaṃ vyāpyam, yathā vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapām | na cātra kṣudhaḥ kāraṇasya vyāpakasya vā kasya cin nivṛttir asti | na ca mohanīyābhāvāt kṣudho 'bhāvaḥ | tasyās tatkāryatvasya tatsvabhavatvasya cāsambhavāt |
analyzed: kāraṇa mātrasya kārya abhāve pi bhāva avirodhāt kāraṇam api nivartamānam āryam nivartayati yathā vahniḥ dhūmam vyāpakam vā nivartamānam vyāpyam yathā vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapām na ca atra kṣudhaḥ kāraṇasya vyāpakasya vā kasya cid nivṛttiḥ asti na ca mohanīya abhāvāt kṣudhaḥ bhāvaḥ tasyāḥ tad kārya tvasya tad svabhava tvasya ca asambhavāt

original: na hi kṣun mohanīyakāryā | vedanīyaprabhavatvāt | anyathā vedanīyaśeṣā ity āgamavirodhāpatteḥ | nanu nāsti virodhaḥ | na hi vayaṃ vedanīyasya kṣutkāraṇatvavāraṇam vidadhmahe kiṃ tu mohanīyam api tatra sahakāritayā vyāpipartīti brūmahe | na ca sahakārikāraṇavirahe 'pi kāryotpattir dṛṣṭacarī |
analyzed: na hi kṣudh mohanīya kāryā vedanīya prabhava tvāt anyathā vedanīya śeṣāḥ iti āgama virodha āpatteḥ nanu nā asti virodhaḥ na hi vayam vedanīyasya kṣudh kāraṇa tva vāraṇam vidadhmahe kim tu mohanīyam api tatra sahakāri tayā vyāpiparti iti brūmahe na ca sahakāri kāraṇa virahe pi kārya utpattiḥ dṛṣṭa carī

original: na khalu bījajalānilātapasamparke pṛthivīvirahe 'ṅkuro jāyata iti cet | naivam | mohanīyasya sahakāritvāsiddheḥ |
analyzed: na khalu bīja jala anila ātapa samparke pṛthivī virahe ṅkuraḥ jāyate iti ced nā evam mohanīyasya sahakāri tva asiddheḥ

original: na hi svābhiprāyānurodhena kiṃ cit kva cit sahakāritayā kalpayitum ucitam | kiṃ tu yasyānvayavyatirekau kāryeṇānuvidhīyete | na cātra kṣun mohanīyavyatirekam anuvidadhatī kvāpi niścitā | nanu siddheṣu tanniścayo bhaviṣyatīti | naivam | sandehāt | tathā hi siddheṣu kiṃ vedanīyābhāvāt kṣun na bhavati, āhosvin mohanīyābhāvād iti |
analyzed: na hi sva abhiprāya anurodhena kim cit kva cit sahakāri tayā kalpayitum ucitam kim tu yasya anvaya vyatirekau kāryeṇa anuvidhīyete na ca atra kṣudh mohanīya vyatirekam anuvidadhatī kvāpi niścitā nanu siddheṣu tad niścayaḥ bhaviṣyati iti na evam sandehāt tathā hi siddheṣu kim vedanīya abhāvāt kṣudh na bhavati āhosvit mohanīya abhāvāt iti

original: bhavasthakevalini kṣudabhāvo mohanīyābhāvaprayukto niścito vedanīyasadbhāvād iti cet | na tatra kṣudabhavasyādyāpi vivādāspadatvāt | nanv evaṃ mohanīyavad eva vedanīyasyāpi kṣutkāraṇatvaṃ na syāt | maivam | kṣutkāraṇatvena tasyobhayasampratipannatvāt | nāpi mohanīyasvabhāvā kṣut | pratipakṣabhāvanānivartyatvaprasaṅgāt |
analyzed: bhava stha kevalini kṣudh abhāvaḥ mohanīya abhāva prayuktaḥ niścitaḥ vedanīya sadbhāvāt iti ced na tatra kṣudh abhavasya adya api vivāda āspada tvāt nanu evam mohanīya vat eva vedanīyasya api kṣudh kāraṇa tvam na syāt mā evam kṣudh kāraṇa tvena tasya ubhaya sampratipanna tvāt nā api mohanīya svabhāvā kṣudh pratipakṣa bhāvanā nivartya tva prasaṅgāt

original: yo hi mohasvabhāvaḥ sa pratipakṣabhāvanayā nivartyate | yathā kṣamādibhāvanayā krodhādiḥ | mohasvabhāvā ca kṣudbhavādbhir iṣṭeti | tathā ca kṣudvedanāpratīkārārthaṃ śāstraṃ pratipakṣabhāvanaivopadiśyeta | na kleśabhūyiṣṭhā dhyānādhyayanavidhātakāriṇī piṇḍeṣaṇā | śītoṣṇabādhātulyatvāc ca kṣudho na mohasvabhāvatvam |
analyzed: yaḥ hi moha svabhāvaḥ sa pratipakṣa bhāvanayā nivartyate yathā kṣamā ādi bhāvanayā krodha ādiḥ moha svabhāvā ca kṣudh bhava adbhiḥ iṣṭā iti tathā ca kṣudh vedanā pratīkāra artham śāstram pratipakṣa bhāvanā eva upadiśyeta na kleśa bhūyiṣṭhā piṇḍa īṣaṇā śīta uṣṇa bādhā tulya tvāt ca kṣudhaḥ na moha svabhāva tvam

original: anyathā tadbādhāyā api mohasvabhāvatvaṃ syāt | nanu bhagavataḥ kṣudupagame 'śeṣajñatvādivirodhaḥ kṣududaye 'smadādivat tatra jñānadarśanaceṣṭādeḥ prakṣayāt | tad asamīcīnam | jñānāvaraṇādiprakṣaye jātāyām api kṣudhi tatkṣayāyogāt |
analyzed: anyathā tad bādhāyāḥ api moha svabhāva tvam syāt nanu bhagavataḥ kṣudh upagame śeṣa jña tva ādi virodhaḥ kṣudh udaye smat ādi vat tatra jñāna darśana ceṣṭā ādeḥ prakṣayāt tat asamīcīnam jñāna āvaraṇa ādi prakṣaye jātāyām api kṣudhi tad kṣaya ayogāt

original: tatkṣayo hi jñānāvaraṇādikarmodayanibandhano 'to 'smadādau tadudayātiśayāt tatkṣayātiśayo yukto bhagavati tu tadāvaraṇader āśeṣasyāpagamāt satyām api kṣudhi na jñānādikṣayaḥ | na hy agnyabhāve saty apīndhane dhūmo bhavati | tad evaṃ pramāṇopapannatvād iti kṣudabhāvasādhako hetur asiddhaḥ | tathā ca kathaṃ bhuktipratiṣedhaḥ |
analyzed: tad kṣayaḥ hi smat ādau tad udaya atiśayāt tad kṣaya atiśayaḥ yuktaḥ bhagavati tu tad āvaraṇa deḥ āśeṣasya apagamāt satyām api kṣudhi na jñāna ādi kṣayaḥ na hi agni abhāve sati api indhane dhūmaḥ bhavati tat evam pramāṇa upapanna tvāt iti kṣudh abhāva sādhakaḥ hetuḥ asiddhaḥ tathā ca katham bhukti pratiṣedhaḥ

original: bhuktisādhakaṃ caitat pramāṇam | vivādaviṣayāpanne kevalini kadā cit kavalāhārabhuktir asti | avikalakāraṇatvāt | yady atrāvikalakāraṇaṃ tat tatrāsti | yathā kva cit pradeśe 'ṅkuraḥ | tathabhūtā ca kadā cit kavalāhārabhuktir vivādaviṣayāpanne kevalini |
analyzed: bhukti sādhakam ca etat pramāṇam vivāda viṣaya āpanne kevalini kadā cit kavala āhāra bhuktiḥ asti avikala kāraṇa tvāt yadi atra avikala kāraṇam tat tatra asti yathā kva cit pradeśe ṅkuraḥ tathabhūtā ca kadā cit kavala āhāra bhuktiḥ vivāda viṣaya āpanne kevalini

original: tasmāt tatra sāstīti | na vātrāsiddho hetuḥ | yataḥ kavalāhāram ukter vidhā kāraṇaṃ bāhyam ābhyantaraṃ ca | tatra bāhyam anaśanādi | tat tāvad asty eva | na tatra kasyāpi vivādaḥ | ābhyantaraṃ paryāptivedyataijasadīrghāyuṣṭvodayalakṣaṇam | tad api vidyata eva | yato hi śarīrendriādiniṣpattiḥ sā paryāptir nāma karmaviśeṣaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt tatra sā asti iti na vā atra asiddhaḥ hetuḥ yatas kavala āhāram ukteḥ vidhā kāraṇam bāhyam ābhyantaram ca tatra bāhyam anaśana ādi tat tāvat asti eva na tatra kasya api vivādaḥ ābhyantaram paryāpti vedya taijasa dīrgha āyuḥ tva udaya lakṣaṇam tat api vidyate eva yatas hi śarīra indri ādi niṣpattiḥ sā paryāptiḥ nāma karma viśeṣaḥ

original: vedyaṃ sukhaduḥkhasampādakaṃ vedanīyākhyaṃ karma | taijasaṃ bhuktānapākādikāraṇoṣmasvarūpāntas taijasaśarīrakāraṇaṃ nāma karma | dīrgham āyuścirajīvanakāraṇaṃ karma | eteṣāṃ udayāt kṣudvedanopajāyate | asti caitad udayo bhagavati sa ca bhuktikāraṇam iti | yad āha śākaṭāyanaḥ asti ca kevalibhuktiḥ samagrahetur yathā purā bhukteḥ |
analyzed: vedyam sukha duḥkha sampādakam vedanīya ākhyam karma taijasam bhukta anapāka ādi kāraṇa ūṣma svarūpa antar taijasa śarīra kāraṇam nāma karma dīrgham āyuḥ cira jīvana kāraṇam karma eteṣām udayāt kṣudh vedanā upajāyate asti ca etat udayaḥ bhagavati sa ca bhukti kāraṇam iti yat āha śākaṭāyanaḥ asti ca kevali bhuktiḥ samagra hetuḥ yathā purā bhukteḥ

original: paryāptivedyataijasadīrghāyuṣkodayo hetuḥ || 1 || iti | yat tu prabhācandreṇābhidhīyate asiddhaṃ cāvikalakāraṇatvaṃ bhukteḥ | mohanīyasahāyaṃ hi yedyādikarma kṣudādikāryakaraṇe 'vikalasāmarthyaṃ bhavati nānyathā | atiprasaṅgāt | yathaiva hi patite sainyanāyake 'sāmarthyaṃ sainyasya | tathā mohavinaṣṭe 'ghātikarmaṇāṃ |
analyzed: paryāpti vedya taijasa dīrgha āyuṣka udayaḥ hetuḥ iti yat tu prabhācandreṇa abhidhīyate asiddham ca avikala kāraṇa tvam bhukteḥ mohanīya sahāyam hi kṣudh ādi kārya karaṇe vikala sāmarthyam bhavati na anyathā atiprasaṅgāt yathā eva hi patite sainya nāyake sāmarthyam sainyasya tathā moha vinaṣṭe ghāti karmaṇām

original: yathā ca nirviṣīkṛtya mantriṇopayujyamānam api viṣaṃ na dāhamurcchādi kartuṃ samartham | tathā śukladhyānānalanirdagdhamohasahāyaṃ vedyādikṣudādikam | prayogaḥ, bhagavati bubhukṣā nāsti tatkāraṇamohābhāvāt, yasya yatra yatkāraṇābhāvo na tatra kāryaṃ yathānagnipradeśe dhūmaḥ | nāsti cārhati moha iti | tad etasyāparyālocitābhidhānam |
analyzed: yathā ca nirviṣīkṛtya mantriṇā upayujyamānam api viṣam na dāha murcchā ādi kartum samartham tathā śukla dhyāna anala nirdagdha moha sahāyam vedi ādi kṣudh ādikam prayogaḥ bhagavati bubhukṣā nā asti tad kāraṇa moha abhāvāt yasya yatra yad kāraṇa abhāvaḥ na tatra kāryam yathā anagni pradeśe dhūmaḥ nā asti ca arhati mohaḥ iti tat etasya aparyālocita abhidhānam

original: mohanīyasahāyakavikalasyāpi nāmādikarmaṇa iva vedanīyādikarmaṇaḥ svakāryakaraṇe virodhābhāvāt | anyathā nāmādikarmāpi kevalini tīrthapravartanādisvakāryakaraṇe kauśalaṃ nāvalambeta | atha nāmādiṣu śudhaprakṛtīnāṃ tatrāpratibaddhasāmarthyatvena svakāryakāritvaṃ yujyate | nanv asātavedyādyaśubhaprakṛtīnāṃ bhagavti vipākodayasyāgame pratipādanāt |
analyzed: mohanīya sahāyaka vikalasya api nāma ādi karmaṇaḥ iva vedanīya ādi karmaṇaḥ sva kārya karaṇe virodha abhāvāt anyathā nāma ādi karma api kevalini tīrtha pravartana ādi sva kārya karaṇe kauśalam na avalambeta atha nāma ādiṣu śudha prakṛtīnām tatra apratibaddha sāmarthya tvena sva kārya kāri tvam yujyate nanu asātavedya ādi aśubha prakṛtīnām vipāka udayasya āgame pratipādanāt

original: dvitīyapakṣe tu na kā cin naḥ pīḍā | kiyato 'py anubhāgasya ghāte 'py asātādyaśubhaprakṛtīnām apratibaddhasāmarthyatayā svakāryakāritvopapatteḥ |
analyzed: dvitīya pakṣe tu na kā cit naḥ pīḍā kiyataḥ pi anubhāgasya ghāte pi asāta ādi aśubha prakṛtīnām apratibaddha sāmarthya tayā sva kārya kāri tva upapatteḥ

original: yadi cāśubhaprakṛtīnāṃ katipayānubhāgaghāti sati pratibaddhasāmarthyatayā na svakāryakāritvam ity āsthīyate | tarhy asthiranāma karmaṇo 'śubhaprakṛtitvena katipayānubhāgaghātasadbhāvāt svakāryakāritvaṃ na syāt | tathā ca bhagavataḥ pāṇipādādayo 'vayavāḥ sthirā eva syur ity ayogiguṇasthānavat sayogiguṇasthānake 'pi bhagavān nirvyāpāra eva bhavet |
analyzed: yadi ca aśubha prakṛtīnām katipaya anubhāga ghāti sati pratibaddha sāmarthya tayā na sva kārya kāri tvam iti āsthīyate tarhi śubha prakṛti tvena katipaya anubhāga ghāta sadbhāvāt sva kārya kāri tvam na syāt tathā ca bhagavataḥ pāṇi pāda ādayaḥ vayavāḥ sthirāḥ eva syuḥ iti ayogi guṇa sthāna vat sayogi guṇa sthānake bhagavān nirvyāpāraḥ eva bhavet

original: tathā ca kutas tīrthapravartanam iti lābham icchato mūlocchedaḥ sampanno 'sya digvāsasaḥ | etena tatkāraṇamohābhāvād ity anantaropanyastahetor viśeṣaṇāsiddhir ity uktaṃ bhavati | mohasya kṣutkāraṇatvāsiddheḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca kutas tīrtha pravartanam iti lābham icchataḥ mūla ucchedaḥ digvāsasaḥ etena tad kāraṇa moha abhāvāt iti anantara upanyasta hetoḥ viśeṣaṇa asiddhiḥ iti uktam bhavati mohasya kṣudh kāraṇa tva asiddheḥ

original: tadabhāve 'pi kevalyavasthāyāṃ kṣutsambhavasya pratipāditatvād iti  yad apy anenaivocyate na ceyaṃ bubhukṣā mohanīyānapekṣasya vedanīyasyaiva kāryaṃ yenātyantaprakṣīṇamohe 'pi syāt | tathā hi bubhukṣā mohanīyānapekṣāsya vedanīyasya kāryaṃ na bhavati | icchātvāt | riraṃsāvat | bhoktum icchā bubhukṣā sā hi kathaṃ vedanīyasyaiva kāryam |
analyzed: tad abhāve pi kevalī avasthāyām kṣudh sambhavasya pratipādita tvāt iti yat api anena eva ucyate na ca iyam bubhukṣā mohanīya anapekṣasya vedanīyasya eva kāryam yena atyanta prakṣīṇa mohe pi syāt tathā hi bubhukṣā mohanīya anapekṣā asya vedanīyasya kāryam na bhavati icchā tvāt riraṃsā vat bhoktum icchā bubhukṣā sā hi katham vedanīyasya eva kāryam

original: anyathā yonyādiṣu rantu icchā riraṃsāpi tasyaiva kāryaṃ syāt | tathā ca kavalāhāravastryādāv api pravṛttiprasaṅgān neśvarād asya viśeṣaḥ | yathā ca riraṃsā pratipakṣabhavanāto nivartate | tathā bubhuksāpi | prayogaḥ bhojanākāṅkṣā pratipakṣabhāvanāto nivartate | ākāṅkṣātvāt | stryādyākāṅkṣāvat iti | tad api sakalam alīkam |
analyzed: anyathā yoni ādiṣu rantu icchā riraṃsā api tasya eva kāryam syāt tathā ca kavala āhāra vastrī ādau api pravṛtti prasaṅgāt na īśvarāt asya viśeṣaḥ yathā ca riraṃsā pratipakṣa bhavanā atas nivartate tathā bubhuksā api prayogaḥ bhojana ākāṅkṣā pratipakṣa bhāvanātaḥ nivartate ākāṅkṣā tvāt strī ādi ākāṅkṣā vat iti tat api sakalam alīkam

original: bubhukṣā mohanīyānapekṣasya vedanīyasya kāryaṃ na bhavatīty atra siddhasādhyatāvatārāt | nanv evaṃ tarhi bhagavaty api mohanīyasadbhāvaprasaktiḥ bubhukṣāsadbhāvād iti cet | na | bubhukṣāsadbhāvasya tatrāsiddheḥ | bhoktum icchā hi bubhukṣā bhojanābhilāṣarūpā sā kathaṃ nirmohe bhagavati syāt |
analyzed: bubhukṣā mohanīya anapekṣasya vedanīyasya kāryam na bhavati iti atra siddha sādhyatā avatārāt nanu evam tarhi bhagavati api mohanīya sadbhāva prasaktiḥ bubhukṣā sadbhāvāt iti ced na bubhukṣā sadbhāvasya tatra asiddheḥ bhoktum icchā hi bubhukṣā bhojana abhilāṣa rūpā sā katham nirmohe bhagavati syāt

original: kathaṃ hanta tarhi bhukte 'sāv iti cet, yathaiva vivakṣām antareṇāpi vakti | jigamiṣām antareṇāpi gacchati | nanv evaṃ kathaṃ bubhuṣā kevalini vidyata iti tatra tatrodghoṣaṇā śreyasīti cet | kāraṇe kāryopacārāt | vedanīyakarmodayajanyapīḍāviśeṣe hi sati śarīriṇāṃ bhojanābhilāṣarūpā bubhukṣopajāyate
analyzed: katham hanta tarhi bhukte sau iti ced yathā eva vivakṣām antareṇa api vakti jigamiṣām antareṇa api gacchati nanu evam katham bubhuṣā kevalini vidyate iti tatra tatra udghoṣaṇā śreyasī iti ced kāraṇe kārya upacārāt vedanīya karma udaya janya pīḍā viśeṣe hi sati śarīriṇām bhojana abhilāṣa rūpā bubhukṣā upajāyate

original: tataś ca kevalini tatkāraṇasya pīḍāviśeṣasya sadbhāvād bubhukṣāsthīti vyavahriyate | etena yonyādiṣu rantum icchā riraṃsetyādi nagnāṭasya bhāṇḍavidyāpāṇḍityaṃ viḍambitam avaseyam | yac cākāṅkṣātvād iti proktam |
analyzed: tatas ca kevalini tad kāraṇasya pīḍā viśeṣasya sadbhāvāt bubhukṣā asthi iti vyavahriyate etena yoni ādiṣu rantum icchā riraṃsā ityādi nagnāṭasya bhāṇḍa vidyā pāṇḍityam viḍambitam avaseyam yat ca ākāṅkṣā tvāt iti proktam

original: tatra pratyakṣabādhā pakṣasya, prabalajājvalyamānajāṭharajātavedasaḥ puṃsaḥ pratipakṣabhāvanālakṣeṇāpi bubhukṣāyā nivṛtter ananubhūyamānatvāt | tato na bhubhukṣā mohanīyakāryam |
analyzed: tatra pratyakṣa bādhā pakṣasya prabala jājvalyamāna jāṭhara jātavedasaḥ puṃsaḥ pratipakṣa bhāvanā lakṣeṇa api bubhukṣāyāḥ nivṛtteḥ ananubhūyamāna tvāt tatas na bhubhukṣā mohanīya kāryam

original: yāni caitāni tenāivoktāni sādhanāni | na bubhukṣāvān kevalī, tadvirodhinirmohasvabhāvopetatvāt, yo yadvirodhisvabhāvopeto nāsau tadvān, yathoṣṇasparśasvabhāvopetaḥ kaś cit pradeśo na śītasparśavān tathā tadvirodhinirmohasvabhāvopetaś ca kevalī, tasmān na bubhukṣāvān iti |
analyzed: yāni ca etāni tena iva uktāni sādhanāni na bubhukṣāvān kevalī tad virodhi nirmoha svabhāva upeta tvāt yaḥ yad virodhi svabhāva upetaḥ na asau tadvān yathā uṣṇa sparśa svabhāva upetaḥ kaḥ cid pradeśaḥ na śīta sparśavān tathā tad virodhi nirmoha svabhāva upetaḥ ca kevalī tasmāt na bubhukṣāvān iti

original: yad duḥkharūpaṃ na tat tatra sambhavati, yathā kāmapīḍādi, duḥkharūpā ca kṣud iti | tathā yathānantaṃ sukhaṃ na tatra duḥkhaleśo 'py asti, yathā siddheṣu, anantasukhaṃ cārhatīti | yathā yad virodhi balavad asti tatrābhyuditakāraṇam api tad bhavati, yathātyuṣṇapradeśe śītam, asti ca kṣudduḥkhavirodhi balavatkevaliny anantaṃ sukham iti |

original: tathā hi tadvirodhinirmohasvabhāvopetatvād iti prathamasādhanaṃ viśeṣaṇāsiddham | tadvirodhitvasyāprasiddheḥ | na khalu bubhukṣāyā nirmohasvabhāvena sārdhaṃ virodhabandho 'py asti | vītamohe bhagavati vedanīyakarmodayanibandhanāyā bubhukṣāyāḥ prasādhitatvād iti | duḥkharūpatvākhyāsādhanam apy anaikāntikam | śītoṣṇabādhayā vyabhicāritvāt |

original: caturtham api kṣudduḥkhavirodhibalavad anantasukhatvalakṣaṇaṃ sādhanam asiddhaṃ anantasukhāsambhavasya bhagavaty anantaram evābhihitatvād iti | atha eva pañcamam api vedyaphalaviruddhānivartyasukhānvitatvasvarūpaṃ sādhanam asiddham evety apakarṇanīyaṃ sakarṇaiḥ | yad api sa eva prameyakamalamārtaṇḍe sādhanam abhidhatte sma |

original: kevalī na bhuṅkte, rāgadveṣābhāvāntavīryasadbhāvānyathānupapatteḥ iti | tad api na prayojakam | rāgadveṣābhāvānantavīryasadbhāvayoḥ kevalini bhuktyabhāvena sārdham anyathānupapatter asambhavāt | bhuktyabhāvam antareṇāpi svakāraṇanibandhanayos tayos tatra virodhābhāvāt |

original: vidyate hi kevalini rāgadveṣābhāvasya kāraṇaṃ mohanīyakarmapralayo 'nantavīryasadbhāvasya ca vīryāntarāyakarmāpagama iti | anantatvaṃ vīryasya parābhyupagameneha samarthitam | asaṅkhyātatvasyaiva tatrāgame 'bhihitatvād iti | kathaṃ caivaṃ vādito 'sya kevalini vacanagamanādikam api ghaṭeta |
analyzed: vidyate hi kevalini rāga dveṣa abhāvasya kāraṇam mohanīya karma pralayaḥ nanta vīrya sadbhāvasya ca vīrya antarāya karma apagamaḥ iti ananta tvam vīryasya para abhyupagamena iha samarthitam asaṅkhyāta tvasya eva tatra āgame bhihita tvāt iti katham ca evam kevalini vacana gamana ādikam api ghaṭeta

original: śakyaṃ hi vaktuṃ na kevalī vakti na gacchati na niṣīdati ca rāgadveṣābhāvānantavīryasadbhāvānyathānupapatter iti | athānyathānupapattivikalatvān nedaṃ sādhanaṃ vacanagamanādyabhāvasya svasādhyasya prayojakam |
analyzed: śakyam hi vaktum na kevalī vakti na gacchati na niṣīdati ca rāga dveṣa abhāva ananta vīrya sadbhāva anyathā anupapatteḥ iti atha anyathā anupapatti vikala tvāt na idam sādhanam vacana gamana ādi abhāvasya sva sādhyasya prayojakam

original: tathā hi rāgadveṣayor abhāve 'nantavīryasadbhāve 'pi ca tīrthapravartanaphalatīrthakṛnnāmakāryodayalakṣaṇataḥ svakāraṇād eva bhagavati vacanagamanādikam upapadyata eva | anyathā tīrthapravṛtter uccheda eva syād iti cet | nanv ata eva bhavadupanyastam api sādhanam kevalibhuktipratiṣedhalakṣaṇasya svasādhyasya prayojakaṃ kathaṃ nāma bhavet |
analyzed: tathā hi rāga dveṣayoḥ abhāve nanta vīrya sadbhāve ca tīrtha pravartana phala tīrthakṛt nāma kārya udaya lakṣaṇataḥ sva kāraṇāt eva bhagavati vacana gamana ādikam upapadyate eva anyathā tīrtha pravṛtteḥ ucchedaḥ eva syāt iti ced nanu atas eva bhavat upanyastam api sādhanam kevali bhukti pratiṣedha lakṣaṇasya sva sādhyasya prayojakam katham nāma bhavet

original: śakyam athāpi hy etad vaktuṃ rāgadveṣayor abhāve 'nantavīryasadbhāve 'pi ca duḥkhotpādaphalād sātāvedanīyakarmodayalakṣanataḥ svakāraṇād eva bhagavati kavalāhārabhuktir upapadyata eva | anyathā kṣudvedanāpratīkāra eva na syād iti |
